#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Source-preserving importer of local Git repository history.

Uses git plumbing to preserve *every reachable commit* and every file at each
revision, not just the latest default-branch snapshot. No network access.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse,hashlib,json,mimetypes,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from build_graph import GraphBuilder,stable_id,as_timestamp


def run_git(repo:Path,*args)->bytes:
    return subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),*args],stderr=subprocess.PIPE)


def ingest_git_history(b:GraphBuilder,repo:Path,namespace:str,remote_name:str|None=None)->dict:
    repo=Path(repo).resolve()
    if not (repo/'.git').exists() and not (repo/'HEAD').exists():
        raise ValueError('Pass an existing Git worktree or bare mirror')
    repo_name=remote_name or repo.name
    stats={'repository':repo_name,'namespace':namespace,'commits':0,'blob_occurrences':0,'previously_registered':0,
           'refs':0,'submodule_references':0,'errors':[]}
    rootid=stable_id('git_repo',namespace,repo_name)
    b.node(rootid,'git_repository',repo_name,metadata={'namespace':namespace,'local_path':str(repo),
      'source':'git_directory','branch_coverage':'all reachable refs and reflogs'},layers=['source','context','junk_drawer'])
    try:
        refs=run_git(repo,'show-ref','--head').decode('utf-8','replace').splitlines()
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
        refs=[]
    for line in refs:
        if ' ' not in line:continue
        sha,name=line.split(' ',1)
        refid=stable_id('git_ref',namespace,repo_name,name)
        try:
            peeled=run_git(repo,'rev-parse','--verify',name+'^{commit}').decode('ascii').strip()
        except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
            peeled=None
        b.node(refid,'git_ref',name,body=sha,
            metadata={'object_sha':sha,'peeled_commit_sha':peeled,'repo':repo_name,
                      'ref_type':'annotated tag/branch/other - inspect Git object to distinguish'},
            layers=['source','timeline','junk_drawer'])
        b.edge(rootid,refid,'HAS_REF',rootid)
        if peeled:
            b.edge(refid,stable_id('git_commit',namespace,repo_name,peeled),'POINTS_AT',rootid,
                   'git_object_verified',{'original_ref_sha':sha,'peeled_commit_sha':peeled})
        stats['refs']+=1
    try:
        commits=run_git(repo,'rev-list','--all','--reflog','--parents').decode('ascii').splitlines()
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
        commits=[]
    for line in commits:
        atoms=line.split();sha=atoms[0];parents=atoms[1:]
        cid=stable_id('git_commit',namespace,repo_name,sha)
        try:
            detail=run_git(repo,'show','-s','--format=%aI%n%cI%n%an%n%ae%n%cn%n%ce%n%s%n%b',sha).decode('utf-8','replace').splitlines()
            author_time=detail[0] if len(detail)>0 else ''
            commit_time=detail[1] if len(detail)>1 else ''
            summary=detail[6] if len(detail)>6 else ''
            body='\n'.join(detail[7:]) if len(detail)>7 else ''
            b.node(cid,'git_commit',sha[:12]+' '+summary,body,
                event_ts=as_timestamp(author_time),recorded_ts=as_timestamp(commit_time),
                metadata={'sha':sha,'parents':parents,'repo':repo_name,'namespace':namespace,
                    'author_time':author_time,'committer_time':commit_time,
                    'author':detail[2] if len(detail)>2 else '',
                    'author_email':detail[3] if len(detail)>3 else '',
                    'committer':detail[4] if len(detail)>4 else '',
                    'committer_email':detail[5] if len(detail)>5 else ''},
                layers=['source','timeline','context','junk_drawer'])
            b.edge(rootid,cid,'HAS_COMMIT',rootid)
            for parent in parents:
                pid=stable_id('git_commit',namespace,repo_name,parent)
                b.edge(cid,pid,'COMMIT_PARENT',rootid,'git_object_verified',{'commit':sha,'parent':parent})
            tree=run_git(repo,'ls-tree','-r','-z','--full-tree',sha)
            for entry in tree.split(b'\0'):
                if not entry:continue
                head,path=entry.split(b'\t',1)
                mode,otype,object_sha=head.decode('ascii').split(' ')
                file_path=path.decode('utf-8','replace')
                if otype=='commit':
                    sid=stable_id('git_submodule',namespace,repo_name,sha,file_path)
                    b.node(sid,'git_submodule',file_path,body=object_sha,
                        source_id=cid,metadata={'repo':repo_name,'commit':sha,'path':file_path,'gitlink_sha':object_sha},layers=['source','junk_drawer'])
                    b.edge(cid,sid,'SUBMODULE_REFERENCE',cid,'git_object_verified')
                    stats['submodule_references']+=1
                    continue
                if otype!='blob':
                    stats['errors'].append({'commit':sha,'path':file_path,'error':'unexpected git object type '+otype})
                    continue
                origin=f'git://{namespace}/{repo_name}/{sha}/{file_path}'
                prior=b.con.execute('SELECT sha256,parse_status FROM sources WHERE path=?',(origin,)).fetchone()
                if prior and prior[1]!='registered':
                    stats['previously_registered']+=1
                    b.edge(cid,stable_id('source',origin),'COMMIT_CONTAINS_FILE',cid,'git_object_verified',
                           {'git_blob_sha':object_sha,'path':file_path,'file_mode':mode})
                    continue
                data=run_git(repo,'cat-file','blob',object_sha)
                # Git SHA1/SHA256 checks are provided by Git; store local SHA256 separately.
                sid=b.source(origin,data,mimetypes.guess_type(file_path)[0] or 'application/octet-stream',
                    metadata={'repo':repo_name,'commit_sha':sha,'git_blob_sha':object_sha,

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Ingest an authenticated GitHub connector tree snapshot with exact blob hashes.

A default-branch snapshot is not confused with a full repository history.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib,json,mimetypes
from pathlib import Path
from build_graph import GraphBuilder,stable_id


def _git_blob_sha(data:bytes)->str:
    return hashlib.sha1(f'blob {len(data)}\0'.encode('ascii')+data).hexdigest()


def ingest_tree_snapshot(b:GraphBuilder,manifest:dict,content_root:Path)->dict:
    repo=str(manifest['repo']);ref=str(manifest['ref'])
    tree_id=stable_id('github_connector_tree',repo,ref,manifest.get('tree_sha',''))
    repo_id=stable_id('repository',repo.partition('/')[0],repo.partition('/')[2])
    if not b.con.execute('SELECT 1 FROM nodes WHERE id=?',(repo_id,)).fetchone():
        b.node(repo_id,'repository_metadata',repo,metadata={'metadata_source':'connector_tree_snapshot'},layers=['source','context','junk_drawer'])
    b.node(tree_id,'git_tree_snapshot',repo+'@'+ref,metadata={
        'tree_sha':manifest.get('tree_sha'),'provider':manifest.get('provider'),
        'tree_truncated':manifest.get('tree_truncated'),
        'file_count_as_returned':len(manifest['files']),
        'semantics':'one observed tree snapshot, not a commit history'},layers=['source','timeline','junk_drawer'])
    b.edge(repo_id,tree_id,'HAS_GITHUB_TREE_SNAPSHOT',tree_id,'provider_observed')
    results={'tree':repo+'@'+ref,'file_entries':len(manifest['files']),'files_registered':0,
             'blob_sha_valid':0,'empty_blobs':0,'already_ingested':0,'errors':[]}
    for item in manifest['files']:
        rel=str(item['path'])
        if '..' in Path(rel).parts or Path(rel).is_absolute():
            raise ValueError('Git tree includes unsafe path')
        path=Path(content_root)/rel
        if item['size']==0 and not path.exists():data=b''
        elif path.is_file():data=path.read_bytes()
        else:
            results['errors'].append({'path':rel,'error':'contents not available from provider'})
            continue
        got=_git_blob_sha(data)
        if len(data)!=item['size'] or got!=item['git_blob_sha']:
            results['errors'].append({'path':rel,'error':'Git blob SHA or size mismatch','observed_sha':got})
            continue
        results['blob_sha_valid']+=1
        if not data:results['empty_blobs']+=1
        tree_version=manifest.get('tree_sha') or stable_id('unversioned_tree',json.dumps(manifest,sort_keys=True))
        origin=f'githubconnector://{repo}/{ref}/{tree_version}/{rel}'
        prev=b.con.execute('SELECT sha256 FROM sources WHERE path=?',(origin,)).fetchone()
        if prev:
            results['already_ingested']+=1;continue
        # Compatibility: the first observed snapshot was imported with the
        # pre-versioned path convention. Reuse it ONLY for identical tree SHA.
        oldorigin=f'githubconnector://{repo}/{ref}/{rel}'
        legacy=b.con.execute('SELECT id,sha256,metadata_json FROM sources WHERE path=?',(oldorigin,)).fetchone()
        if legacy and legacy[1]==hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() and json.loads(legacy[2]).get('tree_sha')==manifest.get('tree_sha'):
            b.edge(tree_id,legacy[0],'TREE_CONTAINS_FILE',tree_id,'provider_observed_git_sha_verified',
                   {'git_blob_sha':got,'path':rel,'size':len(data)})
            results['already_ingested']+=1;continue
        sid=b.source(origin,data,mimetypes.guess_type(rel)[0] or 'application/octet-stream',
            metadata={'original_byte_stream_present':True,'provider':'authenticated_GitHub_connector',
                'repo':repo,'ref':ref,'path':rel,'git_blob_sha':got,
                'git_blob_sha1_verified_locally':True,'tree_sha':manifest.get('tree_sha'),
                'file_mode':item.get('mode'),'source_kind':'single_tree_snapshot'})
        b.ingest_file_bytes(sid,data,rel)
        b.edge(tree_id,sid,'TREE_CONTAINS_FILE',tree_id,'provider_observed_git_sha_verified',
            {'git_blob_sha':got,'path':rel,'size':len(data)})
        results['files_registered']+=1
    b.con.commit()
    return results


if __name__=='__main__':
    here=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    b=GraphBuilder(here/'GMRI_universal_stage1.sqlite')
    manifest=json.loads((here/'GITHUB_TONYAI_TREE_RECEIPT.json').read_text())
    result=ingest_tree_snapshot(b,manifest,here/'work/github_tonyai')
    print(json.dumps({'result':result,'validation':b.validate()},indent=2))
    b.close()
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Append *all* files under an explicitly supplied local export directory.

Preserves duplicate occurrences and directory topology. A symlink is recorded as
an observable symlink, never followed outside the export. Re-runs are idempotent.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse,hashlib,json,mimetypes,os
from pathlib import Path
from build_graph import GraphBuilder,stable_id


def index_tree(b:GraphBuilder, root:Path, namespace:str)->dict:
    root=Path(root).resolve(strict=True)
    if not root.is_dir():raise ValueError('Expected an existing directory')
    namespace=str(namespace).strip()
    if not namespace:raise ValueError('A stable import namespace is required')
    totals={'namespace':namespace,'root':str(root),'original_files_registered':0,
            'previously_registered':0,'directories_registered':0,'symlinks_registered':0,
            'errors':[]}
    # os.walk avoids following directory symlinks. It includes hidden entries.
    for base,subdirs,files in os.walk(root,followlinks=False):
        for sub in list(subdirs):
            path=Path(base)/sub
            rel=path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
            if path.is_symlink():
                subdirs.remove(sub)
                _symbol(b,path,namespace,rel);totals['symlinks_registered']+=1
            else:
                nid=stable_id('folder','snapshot',namespace,rel)
                b.node(nid,'directory_record',rel,metadata={'namespace':namespace,'tree_relative_path':rel},layers=['source','junk_drawer'])
                totals['directories_registered']+=1
        for file in sorted(files):
            path=Path(base)/file
            rel=path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
            if path.is_symlink():
                _symbol(b,path,namespace,rel);totals['symlinks_registered']+=1;continue
            src_path=f'snapshot://{namespace}/{rel}'
            try:
                stat=path.stat()
                prior=b.con.execute('SELECT sha256,parse_status,bytes FROM sources WHERE path=?',(src_path,)).fetchone()
                new_version_of=None
                if prior:
                    with open(path,'rb') as f:
                        sha=hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
                    if prior[0]==sha and prior[1]!='registered':
                        totals['previously_registered']+=1;continue
                    if prior[0]!=sha:
                        new_version_of=stable_id('source',src_path)
                        src_path+='?version_sha256='+sha
                        vprior=b.con.execute('SELECT sha256,parse_status FROM sources WHERE path=?',(src_path,)).fetchone()
                        if vprior and vprior[0]==sha and vprior[1]!='registered':
                            totals['previously_registered']+=1;continue
                data=path.read_bytes()
                sid=b.source(src_path,data,mimetypes.guess_type(file)[0] or 'application/octet-stream',
                    metadata={'source':'original_local_export_bytes','original_byte_stream_present':True,
                              'namespace':namespace,'relative_path':rel,'mtime_ns':stat.st_mtime_ns})
                if new_version_of:
                    b.edge(sid,new_version_of,'NEW_VERSION_OF',sid,'hash_confirmed',{'same_relative_path':rel})
                if path.suffix.lower()=='.zip':b.ingest_zip(sid,data,src_path)
                else:b.ingest_file_bytes(sid,data,path.name)
                totals['original_files_registered']+=1
            except Exception as exc:
                b.con.execute('insert into events(event_kind,note) values(?,?)',
                    ('local_ingest_error',json.dumps({'namespace':namespace,'relative_path':rel,'error':str(exc)})))
                totals['errors'].append({'path':rel,'error':str(exc)})
            b.con.commit()
    return totals


def _symbol(b,path,namespace,rel):
    try:target=os.readlink(path)
    except OSError:target='UNRESOLVED'
    ident=stable_id('symlink',namespace,rel)
    b.node(ident,'symlink_reference',rel,metadata={'namespace':namespace,'relative_path':rel,'literal_link_target':target,
          'followed':False},layers=['source','junk_drawer'])


def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Ingest all local files in a source export tree, retaining each occurrence')
    ap.add_argument('--directory',required=True,type=Path,help='The original source export root')
    ap.add_argument('--namespace',required=True,help='Stable name: e.g. library-export-2026-10-28')
    ap.add_argument('--db',type=Path,default=Path(__file__).resolve().parent/'GMRI_universal_stage1.sqlite')
    opts=ap.parse_args();b=GraphBuilder(opts.db)
    try:
        result=index_tree(b,opts.directory,opts.namespace);b.close()
        print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
        if result['errors']:raise SystemExit('Import logged errors; review results before accepting completeness')
    finally:
        try:b.con.close()
        except Exception:pass


if __name__=='__main__':main()

# GMRI — EVERYTHING 4D Private Research Workbench

**Built 2026-10-28.** The release contains its evidence graph, live local explorer, complete available original source attachments, connected Library text extracts, verified Drive downloads, a verified GitHub tree snapshot, original graph author assertions, and reproducible source-handling code.

## Run the working research environment

1. Unzip the release; open a terminal in `WORKBENCH/`.
2. Run `python3 server.py`. Python 3.10+ with built-in `sqlite3` suffices to **browse** the completed database, with no cloud connection or third-party packages.
3. Copy the randomly generated **ACCESS TOKEN** shown in that terminal.
4. Open `http://127.0.0.1:8765/` **on that same computer** and enter the token.
5. Search or browse the unfiltered drawer; open a source, view all text in 20,000-character pages, inspect edges and original identities, compare event time with recorded time, trace recorded paths, use fishbone categories, or export Mermaid.

The explorer never requests an external API, and the local server listens only on loopback by default. Browsing works offline. Large sources are served on demand rather than embedded in a huge page. The `GMRI_Offline_4D_Explorer.html` is also included as an entirely self-contained offline snapshot, but the server workbench is the preferred iPad-responsive interface.

For access from an iPad rather than the same computer, expose the server only on a private network **with real TLS**: e.g., `python3 server.py --host 0.0.0.0 --tls-cert /path/to/certificate.pem --tls-key /path/to/key.pem`, and restrict access to your private network, using a hostname and certificate trusted by the iPad. The server rejects non-loopback binding without TLS. This release does not install a service, create trusted certificates, or configure remote access on your Mac. Never publish the bundle or disable authentication to make iPad access easier.

## What the archive contains

- `WORKBENCH/GMRI_universal_stage1.sqlite` — full-text FTS5 source graph, messages, original graph claim nodes, event and record time, evidence-state edges, source register. The `stage1` basename remains for **incremental database compatibility**; the contents have been extended by the v2 import.
- `WORKBENCH/explorer.html`, `app.js`, `style.css`, `server.py` — private searchable 4D web explorer with authentication and paginated source bodies.
- `WORKBENCH/GMRI_universal_stage1.graphml` and `.json.gz` — directed graph exchange formats; full node text and source IDs, not only labels.
- `WORKBENCH/GMRI_Offline_4D_Explorer.html` — self-contained read-only standalone visualization.
- `WORKBENCH/edge_register.csv`, `node_register.csv`, `source_manifest.csv` — inspectable machine-readable registers.
- `ORIGINALS/` — **32 byte-for-byte originals** from the initial mounted-source archive, including the 2023 and 2024 chat export ZIPs and complete 2026 JSON transcripts.
- `DRIVE_ORIGINALS/` — **16 exact downloaded non-native Drive files**, prefixed with their stable provider IDs.
- `LIBRARY_EXTRACTS/` — **116 extraction artifacts from 86 unique Library identities** (duplicate extraction captures retained). These are *indexed text representations*, not original Library binary copies.
- `WORKBENCH/work/github_tonyai/` — two SHA1-verified non-empty files fetched from the TonyAI `main` tree. The other six files in that tree are zero-byte blobs, verified by their standard Git empty-blob SHA and represented in the graph. This is one branch snapshot, not the complete history of the other 99 repos.
- `MANIFEST_CONTENT.json`, `SHA256SUMS.txt` — archive-entry digests; `WORKBENCH/COVERAGE_LEDGER.json` is the current reproducible completion ledger.
- `WORKBENCH/VERIFICATION_RECEIPT.json` — tests and independent graph reconciliation.

All 2,575 Library entries were inventoried by the connector; only 86 unique source identities yielded text extracts into this runtime. The archive does **not** assert possession of the other original Library bytes. Source access denials and external connector limitations cannot be treated as evidence that a source does not exist. The live Google Drive crawl and complete Git histories have not been fully transferred. `COVERAGE_LEDGER.json` states the exact unclosed gates in one machine-readable place.

## Extend with complete original exports without changing the evidence standard

The intake is *not* dependent on topic keywords, relevance ratings, or the author's current argument. It registers **everything** under an explicitly supplied folder, including duplicates and apparently tangential files. In the unpacked `WORKBENCH/` directory:

```bash
# Entire ChatGPT Library export directory, with all original bytes included.
python3 ingest_tree.py --directory /path/to/complete-Library-export --namespace library-export-2026-10-28

# Entire Drive download/export directory; preserve filenames and byte-identical originals.
python3 ingest_tree.py --directory /path/to/full-Drive-export --namespace drive-export-2026-10-28

# Complete local Git clone/mirror for every repository, including reachable commit snapshots.
python3 ingest_git_history.py --repository /path/to/oldmangrizzz/some-repo --repo-full-name oldmangrizzz/some-repo --namespace github-full-history

# If files have been added, update source and alternate formats (lxml required for GraphML):
python3 rebuild_coverage.py
python3 export_graph.py
```

For **bulk ingestion** (rather than browsing), install `pymupdf` for PDFs, `python-docx` for Word documents, and `lxml` for GraphML exports. Python, Git and sufficient disk space are required. Do **not** treat a package whose importer reported errors or missing source entries as complete. For repeated ingests, source identity + SHA protect idempotency and preserve changed versions; a same-named file with different content is a distinct version that needs investigation.

Source classification rules: original bytes are checksummed as bytes; Library extraction is checksummed **as extraction**, not misrepresented as a raw original; metadata-only GitHub inventory does not imply code review; historical graph “verified” labels remain attributed to the original graph author; lexical links are navigation, not causal conclusions. Two different timestamps, **when the event happened** and **when the record was recorded/exported**, remain distinct. FTS indexes the entire available extracted text, not a curated paragraph list.

## Verification and acceptance

Automated suite: **34 tests** as of this release (source and archive idempotence, exact Git blob hash, nested ZIPs, malformed login requests, source-page retrieval, temporal filters, original binary retention, existing graph merge, schema and view contract). SQLite integrity and GraphML-to-SQL counts are separately reconciled in `VERIFICATION_RECEIPT.json`. The available Chromium runtime was blocked by administrator policy from navigating even to localhost, so there is no fabricated browser clickthrough PASS. A live HTTP/API call path was exercised through Python's standard-library client instead.

**Acceptance definition:** all source identities discovered, all authorized original bytes acquired, all recovered text/relations indexed, each edge source state documented, zero unaccounted extraction errors, reproducible graph integrity and UI runtime acceptance. The build carries a machine-readable ledger of which of these conditions it has actually proved.

def ingest_extracted_library(b:GraphBuilder, directory:Path) -> dict:
    root=Path(directory)
    files=sorted(p for p in root.rglob('*.txt') if ID_RE.match(p.name))
    registered=set();stale=0;different=0;count=0;failures=[]
    for path in files:
        m=ID_RE.match(path.name)
        file_id,name=m.groups()
        # Remove optional duplicate suffix that the materializer adds. The
        # primary durable identity is file_id, not its presentation filename.
        name=re.sub(r'_\d+(?=\.txt$)','',name)
        origin='library://'+file_id+'/'+name
        try:
            data=path.read_bytes()
            digest=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
            row=b.con.execute('SELECT sha256 FROM sources WHERE path=?',(origin,)).fetchone()
            if row:
                if row[0]==digest:stale+=1;continue
                different+=1
                origin+='?alternate_extract='+digest[:16]
            elif file_id in registered:
                stale+=1;continue
            registered.add(file_id)
            sid=b.source(origin,data,'text/plain',status='text_extracted_original_binary_not_held',metadata={
                'library_file_id':file_id,'materialized_as':'text','original_byte_stream_present':False,
                'extract_sha256':digest,'extract_size_bytes':len(data),
                'original_filename_sanitized':name,'representation_is_not_original':True,
                'provider':'ChatGPT_Library','materialization_path':str(path)})
            b.ingest_text(sid,data.decode('utf-8',errors='replace'),
                metadata={'text_representation':'library_extracted','original_format_unknown_until_catalog_join':True,
                          'source_file_id':file_id})
            count+=1
            if count%100==0:b.con.commit()
        except Exception as exc:
            failures.append({'path':str(path),'error':str(exc)})
            b.con.execute('INSERT INTO events(event_kind,note) VALUES (?,?)',('library_text_ingest_error',str(path)+' '+str(exc)))
    b.con.commit()
    return {'examined_extract_files':len(files),'content_files':count,'already_ingested':stale,
            'different_extraction_versions':different,'failures':failures}


def merge_all_prior_graphs(b:GraphBuilder, directory:Path) -> list[dict]:
    directory=Path(directory);out=[]
    for f in directory.glob('*.txt'):
        if 'GMRI_Private_Full_Evidence_Graph_v2.json' in f.name:
            graph=json.loads(repair_embedded_controls(f.read_text('utf-8')))
            out.append(merge_legacy_graph(b,graph,'library:file_00000000102481f580273ea74989abaf','evidence_graph_v2'))
        if 'GMRI_4D_Library_Expanded_Interactive_Explorer.html' in f.name:
            graph=parse_html_graph(f.read_text('utf-8'))
            out.append(merge_legacy_graph(b,graph,'library:file_0000000000a481f5983bf952866f0531','library_4d_expanded'))
    b.con.commit();return out

#!/usr/bin/env python3

PATTERNS = {key:[re.compile(p, re.I) for p in pat] for key,pat in TOPIC_ALIASES.items()}
TOPIC_GROUPS = list(TOPIC_ALIASES)
TOPIC_REGEX = re.compile('|'.join('(?P<T%d>%s)' % (i, '|'.join('(?:%s)' % p for p in TOPIC_ALIASES[topic])) for i, topic in enumerate(TOPIC_GROUPS)), re.I)

def sha_bytes(data:bytes)->str: return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def stable_id(prefix:str,*pieces)->str:
    return prefix+':'+hashlib.sha256('|'.join(map(str,pieces)).encode()).hexdigest()[:24]
def normalize_content(obj)->str:
    if obj is None: return ''
    if isinstance(obj,str):return obj
    if isinstance(obj,(int,float,bool)):return str(obj)
    if isinstance(obj,list):return '\n'.join(normalize_content(x) for x in obj)
    if isinstance(obj,dict):
        if 'parts' in obj:return normalize_content(obj['parts'])
        if 'text' in obj and isinstance(obj['text'],(str,dict,list)):return normalize_content(obj['text'])
        if 'content' in obj and isinstance(obj['content'],(str,dict,list)):return normalize_content(obj['content'])
        return json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,default=str)
    return str(obj)
def as_timestamp(t):
    if t is None or t=='': return None
    if isinstance(t,(int,float)):
        # Epoch numbers are returned verbatim; event times may predate upload.
        return float(t)
    try:
        s=str(t).strip().replace('Z','+00:00')
        return dt.datetime.fromisoformat(s).timestamp()
    except Exception:return None

def _topic_anchor(pattern:str)->str:
    """Return a mandatory literal stem; no narrowing by topic relevance."""
    simplified=pattern
    for meta in (r'\b',r'\w+',r'\w*',r'\d+',r'\d*'):
        simplified=simplified.replace(meta,' ')
    simplified=re.sub(r'[A-Za-z]\?', ' ', simplified)
    m=re.search(r'[A-Za-z]{2,}', simplified)
    return m.group().casefold() if m else ''

TOPIC_PREFILTERS = {
    topic: [(p, _topic_anchor(raw)) for raw,p in zip(TOPIC_ALIASES[topic],PATTERNS[topic])]
    for topic in TOPIC_GROUPS
}

def extract_topics(text:str)->set[str]:
    """Exact regex matches with literal fast prefilter, across ALL text."""
    if not text:return set()
    folded=text.casefold()
    found=set()
    for topic,patanchors in TOPIC_PREFILTERS.items():
        for pattern, anchor in patanchors:
            if (not anchor or anchor in folded) and pattern.search(text):
                found.add(topic)
                break
    return found

def extract_docx(data:bytes)->list[tuple[str,str,dict]]:
    from docx import Document
    d=Document(io.BytesIO(data));sections=[]
    for i,p in enumerate(d.paragraphs):
        if p.text.strip():sections.append((f'paragraph:{i+1}',p.text,{'paragraph':i+1,'style':p.style.name if p.style else ''}))
    for it,table in enumerate(d.tables):
        for ir,row in enumerate(table.rows):
            s=' | '.join(cell.text for cell in row.cells)
            if s.strip():sections.append((f'table:{it+1}:row:{ir+1}',s,{'table':it+1,'row':ir+1}))
    return sections

def extract_pdf(data:bytes)->list[tuple[str,str,dict]]:
    import fitz
    doc=fitz.open(stream=data,filetype='pdf')
    output=[]
    for n,p in enumerate(doc):
        try:
            text=p.get_text('text',sort=True)
            images=len(p.get_images(full=False))
            output.append((f'page:{n+1}',text,{'page':n+1,'raster_images':images,'text_extracted':bool(text.strip())}))
        except Exception as e:output.append((f'page:{n+1}','',{'page':n+1,'error':str(e)}))
    return output

from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3

DB=ROOT/'GMRI_universal_stage1.sqlite'


def test_database_has_no_drive_source_identity():
    with sqlite3.connect(DB) as c:
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from sources where path like 'drive://%' or path like '%google_drive%' ").fetchone()[0] == 0
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from nodes where kind like 'drive_%'").fetchone()[0] == 0


def test_both_authorized_source_families_are_present():
    with sqlite3.connect(DB) as c:
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from nodes where kind='repository_metadata'").fetchone()[0] == 100
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from sources where path like 'library://%'").fetchone()[0] > 0


def test_library_evidence_preserves_extraction_status():
    with sqlite3.connect(DB) as c:
        rows=c.execute("select metadata_json,parse_status from sources where path like 'library://%'").fetchall()
        assert rows
        for metadata,status in rows:
            assert status=='text_extracted_original_binary_not_held'
            assert 'original_byte_stream_present": false' in metadata.lower()


def test_github_observed_files_have_own_provenance():
    with sqlite3.connect(DB) as c:
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from sources where path like 'githubconnector://%' ").fetchone()[0] >= 8

import json, sqlite3, sys, zipfile
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from build_graph import GraphBuilder, normalize_content, as_timestamp, extract_topics


def test_unknown_binary_is_included_and_flagged(tmp_path):
    root=tmp_path/'src';root.mkdir()
    (root/'unknown.bin').write_bytes(b'\x00\xff\x03')
    b=GraphBuilder(tmp_path/'g.db');b.ingest_root(root);b.close()
    with sqlite3.connect(tmp_path/'g.db') as c:
        r=c.execute("select parse_status from sources where path like '%unknown.bin'").fetchone()
        assert r and r[0]=='metadata_only_binary'
        assert c.execute('select count(*) from nodes where kind="source_file"').fetchone()[0]==1


def test_branched_chat_history_preserves_every_map_entry(tmp_path):
    root=tmp_path/'src';root.mkdir()
    sample=[{'id':'conv-id','title':'A','create_time':10,'update_time':20,
      'mapping':{'root':{'id':'root','message':None,'parent':None,'children':['one','two']},
       'one':{'id':'one','message':{'id':'one','author':{'role':'user'},'content':{'parts':['Hello']},'create_time':11},'parent':'root','children':[]},
       'two':{'id':'two','message':{'id':'two','author':{'role':'assistant'},'content':{'parts':['Different branch']},'create_time':12},'parent':'root','children':[]}}}]
    with zipfile.ZipFile(root/'test.zip','w') as z:z.writestr('conversations.json',json.dumps(sample))
    b=GraphBuilder(tmp_path/'g.db');b.ingest_root(root);b.close()
    with sqlite3.connect(tmp_path/'g.db') as c:
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from nodes where kind='message_legacy'").fetchone()[0]==3
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from edges where relation='PARENT_OF'").fetchone()[0]==2
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from nodes where kind='message_legacy' and body=''").fetchone()[0]==1
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from edges e left join nodes n on n.id=e.dst where n.id is null").fetchone()[0]==0


def test_duplicate_files_are_not_lost(tmp_path):
    root=tmp_path/'src';root.mkdir()
    (root/'first.md').write_text('text',encoding='utf-8')
    (root/'second.md').write_text('text',encoding='utf-8')
    b=GraphBuilder(tmp_path/'g.db');b.ingest_root(root);b.close()
    with sqlite3.connect(tmp_path/'g.db') as c:
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from sources").fetchone()[0]==2
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from edges where relation='SAME_BYTES_AS'").fetchone()[0]==1

    root=tmp_path/'src';root.mkdir()

    b=GraphBuilder(tmp_path/'g.db');b.ingest_root(root);b.close()
    with sqlite3.connect(tmp_path/'g.db') as c:

def test_incremental_sources_also_enter_full_text_search(tmp_path):
    db=tmp_path/'g.db'
    a=GraphBuilder(db)
    x=a.source('first.md',b'grapefruits','text/markdown')
    a.ingest_file_bytes(x,b'grapefruits','first.md');a.close()
    b=GraphBuilder(db)
    y=b.source('later.md',b'kumquats','text/markdown')
    b.ingest_file_bytes(y,b'kumquats','later.md');b.close()
    with sqlite3.connect(db) as c:
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from nodes_fts where nodes_fts match 'kumquats'").fetchone()[0]>=1

if __name__=='__main__':main()

        if peeled:
            b.edge(refid,stable_id('git_commit',namespace,repo_name,peeled),'POINTS_AT',rootid,
                   'git_object_verified',{'original_ref_sha':sha,'peeled_commit_sha':peeled})
        stats['refs']+=1
    try:
        commits=run_git(repo,'rev-list','--all','--reflog','--parents').decode('ascii').splitlines()
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
        commits=[]
    for line in commits:
        atoms=line.split();sha=atoms[0];parents=atoms[1:]
        cid=stable_id('git_commit',namespace,repo_name,sha)
        try:
            detail=run_git(repo,'show','-s','--format=%aI%n%cI%n%an%n%ae%n%cn%n%ce%n%s%n%b',sha).decode('utf-8','replace').splitlines()
            author_time=detail[0] if len(detail)>0 else ''
            commit_time=detail[1] if len(detail)>1 else ''
            summary=detail[6] if len(detail)>6 else ''
            body='\n'.join(detail[7:]) if len(detail)>7 else ''
            b.node(cid,'git_commit',sha[:12]+' '+summary,body,
                event_ts=as_timestamp(author_time),recorded_ts=as_timestamp(commit_time),
                metadata={'sha':sha,'parents':parents,'repo':repo_name,'namespace':namespace,
                    'author_time':author_time,'committer_time':commit_time,
                    'author':detail[2] if len(detail)>2 else '',
                    'author_email':detail[3] if len(detail)>3 else '',
                    'committer':detail[4] if len(detail)>4 else '',
                    'committer_email':detail[5] if len(detail)>5 else ''},
                layers=['source','timeline','context','junk_drawer'])
            b.edge(rootid,cid,'HAS_COMMIT',rootid)
            for parent in parents:
                pid=stable_id('git_commit',namespace,repo_name,parent)
                b.edge(cid,pid,'COMMIT_PARENT',rootid,'git_object_verified',{'commit':sha,'parent':parent})
            tree=run_git(repo,'ls-tree','-r','-z','--full-tree',sha)
            for entry in tree.split(b'\0'):
                if not entry:continue
                head,path=entry.split(b'\t',1)
                mode,otype,object_sha=head.decode('ascii').split(' ')
                file_path=path.decode('utf-8','replace')
                if otype=='commit':
                    sid=stable_id('git_submodule',namespace,repo_name,sha,file_path)
                    b.node(sid,'git_submodule',file_path,body=object_sha,
                        source_id=cid,metadata={'repo':repo_name,'commit':sha,'path':file_path,'gitlink_sha':object_sha},layers=['source','junk_drawer'])
                    b.edge(cid,sid,'SUBMODULE_REFERENCE',cid,'git_object_verified')
                    stats['submodule_references']+=1
                    continue
                if otype!='blob':
                    stats['errors'].append({'commit':sha,'path':file_path,'error':'unexpected git object type '+otype})
                    continue
                origin=f'git://{namespace}/{repo_name}/{sha}/{file_path}'
                prior=b.con.execute('SELECT sha256,parse_status FROM sources WHERE path=?',(origin,)).fetchone()
                if prior and prior[1]!='registered':
                    stats['previously_registered']+=1
                    b.edge(cid,stable_id('source',origin),'COMMIT_CONTAINS_FILE',cid,'git_object_verified',
                           {'git_blob_sha':object_sha,'path':file_path,'file_mode':mode})
                    continue
                data=run_git(repo,'cat-file','blob',object_sha)
                # Git SHA1/SHA256 checks are provided by Git; store local SHA256 separately.
                sid=b.source(origin,data,mimetypes.guess_type(file_path)[0] or 'application/octet-stream',
                    metadata={'repo':repo_name,'commit_sha':sha,'git_blob_sha':object_sha,
                              'file_path':file_path,'file_mode':mode,'original_byte_stream_present':True,
                              'source':'git cat-file blob'})
                if file_path.lower().endswith('.zip'):b.ingest_zip(sid,data,origin)
                else:b.ingest_file_bytes(sid,data,file_path)
                b.edge(cid,sid,'COMMIT_CONTAINS_FILE',cid,'git_object_verified',
                       {'git_blob_sha':object_sha,'path':file_path,'file_mode':mode})
                stats['blob_occurrences']+=1
            stats['commits']+=1
            b.con.commit()
        except Exception as exc:
            msg={'repo':repo_name,'commit':sha,'error':str(exc)}
            stats['errors'].append(msg)
            b.con.execute('INSERT INTO events(event_kind,note) VALUES (?,?)',('git_import_error',json.dumps(msg)))
    return stats


def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Import entire Git reachable commit history, all refs')
    ap.add_argument('--repository',required=True,type=Path)
    ap.add_argument('--namespace',required=True)
    ap.add_argument('--repo-full-name',help='owner/repo; defaults to directory basename')
    ap.add_argument('--db',type=Path,default=Path(__file__).resolve().parent/'GMRI_universal_stage1.sqlite')
    opts=ap.parse_args();b=GraphBuilder(opts.db)
    try:
        status=ingest_git_history(b,opts.repository,opts.namespace,opts.repo_full_name)
        b.close();print(json.dumps(status,indent=2))
        if status['errors']:raise SystemExit('Git import recorded errors; see event ledger')
    finally:
        try:b.con.close()
        except Exception:pass


if __name__=='__main__':main()


def test_content_converters_and_no_topic_filter():
    assert normalize_content({'parts':['a',{'content_type':'image_asset_pointer','asset_pointer':'ref'}]}) != ''
    assert as_timestamp('2025-05-18T17:55:00-05:00') is not None
    txt='Narrative of TONYAI, neurodatabase, SAGE, and EMS all relevant without filtering.'
    found=extract_topics(txt)
    assert {'tonyai','neurodatabase','sage','ems'}.issubset(found)


def test_full_text_index_includes_unselected_documents(tmp_path):
    root=tmp_path/'src';root.mkdir()
    (root/'randomest_note.md').write_text('The asparagus crosses the world line.',encoding='utf-8')
    b=GraphBuilder(tmp_path/'g.db');b.ingest_root(root);b.close()
    with sqlite3.connect(tmp_path/'g.db') as c:
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from nodes_fts where nodes_fts match 'asparagus'").fetchone()[0]>=1

def test_incremental_sources_also_enter_full_text_search(tmp_path):
    db=tmp_path/'g.db'
    a=GraphBuilder(db)
    x=a.source('first.md',b'grapefruits','text/markdown')
    a.ingest_file_bytes(x,b'grapefruits','first.md');a.close()
    b=GraphBuilder(db)
    y=b.source('later.md',b'kumquats','text/markdown')
    b.ingest_file_bytes(y,b'kumquats','later.md');b.close()
    with sqlite3.connect(db) as c:
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from nodes_fts where nodes_fts match 'kumquats'").fetchone()[0]>=1

"""Reconstruct every reachable commit and file occurrence from a local git mirror."""
import os,sqlite3,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from build_graph import GraphBuilder
from ingest_git_history import ingest_git_history


def git(repo,*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),*args],stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).decode().strip()


def test_git_import_records_all_reachable_commits_blobs_and_parent_edges(tmp_path):
    repo=tmp_path/'repo';repo.mkdir()
    git(repo,'init','-q')
    git(repo,'config','user.name','Test Author')
    git(repo,'config','user.email','test@example.invalid')
    (repo/'a.md').write_text('FIRST hypothesis first branch')
    git(repo,'add','a.md');git(repo,'commit','-qm','first')
    (repo/'a.md').write_text('SECOND version with correction')
    (repo/'b.txt').write_text('fascinating unrelated side note')
    git(repo,'add','.');git(repo,'commit','-qm','second')
    b=GraphBuilder(tmp_path/'graph.db')
    r=ingest_git_history(b,repo,'research-2026','oldmangrizzz/local-copy')
    assert r['commits']==2 and r['blob_occurrences']==3
    assert r['errors']==[]
    b.close()
    with sqlite3.connect(tmp_path/'graph.db') as c:
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from nodes where kind='git_commit'").fetchone()[0]==2
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from edges where relation='COMMIT_PARENT'").fetchone()[0]==1
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from sources where path like 'git://%'").fetchone()[0]==3
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from nodes_fts where nodes_fts match 'fascinating'").fetchone()[0]==1
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from nodes_fts where nodes_fts match 'FIRST'").fetchone()[0]>=1
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from nodes_fts where nodes_fts match 'SECOND'").fetchone()[0]>=1

def test_every_required_dom_id_is_present_and_js_parses():
    h=(P/'explorer.html').read_text('utf-8')
    js=(P/'app.js').read_text('utf-8')
    declared=set(re.findall(r'\bid="([^"]+)"',h))

    assert v.returncode==0,v.stderr

    return subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),*args],stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).decode().strip()


def test_repo_manifest_includes_all_observed_repositories():
    items=repository_names(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'connector_seed.json')
    assert len(items)==100 and len(set(items))==100
    assert 'oldmangrizzz/TonyAI' in items
    assert 'oldmangrizzz/uatu-engine' in items
    assert 'oldmangrizzz/EPD-The-digital-person' in items


def test_full_acquisition_ingests_all_branches_and_library_junk(tmp_path):
    work=tmp_path/'input';work.mkdir()
    mirrors=tmp_path/'mirrors';mirrors.mkdir()
    repo=tmp_path/'source';repo.mkdir()
    git(repo,'init','-q')
    git(repo,'config','user.name','Test')
    git(repo,'config','user.email','test@example.invalid')
    (repo/'source.txt').write_text('an ordinary conversation')
    git(repo,'add','.');git(repo,'commit','-qm','initial')
    git(repo,'checkout','-qb','tangent')
    (repo/'tangent.md').write_text('golden beetle branch never merged')
    git(repo,'add','.');git(repo,'commit','-qm','tangent branch')
    git(repo,'checkout','-q','master')
    git(repo,'tag','v1')
    mirror=mirrors/'repo.git'
    subprocess.run(['git','clone','-q','--mirror',str(repo),str(mirror)],check=True)
    junk=work/'junk';junk.mkdir()
    (junk/'unrelated.txt').write_text('the pickled asparagus fox')
    (junk/'copy.txt').write_text('the pickled asparagus fox')
    db=tmp_path/'graph.sqlite'
    result=acquire_local_sources(db,work,mirrors,['oldmangrizzz/repo'],'unit-test')
    assert result['github']['repositories_imported']==1
    assert result['github']['repos_missing']==[]
    assert result['github']['commits']>=2
    assert result['library']['original_files_registered']==2
    with sqlite3.connect(db) as c:
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from nodes_fts where nodes_fts match 'beetle'").fetchone()[0]>0
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from nodes_fts where nodes_fts match 'asparagus'").fetchone()[0]>0
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from sources where path like 'git://%'").fetchone()[0]>=3
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from sources where path like 'snapshot://%'").fetchone()[0]==2
        assert c.execute("select count(*) from edges where relation='SAME_BYTES_AS'").fetchone()[0]>=1


def test_unavailable_git_mirrors_are_reported_not_silently_skipped(tmp_path):
    root=tmp_path/'lib';root.mkdir()
    mirrors=tmp_path/'git';mirrors.mkdir()
    result=acquire_local_sources(tmp_path/'g.sqlite',root,mirrors,['oldmangrizzz/far-away'],'local')
    assert result['github']['repositories_imported']==0
    assert result['github']['repos_missing']==['oldmangrizzz/far-away']

bash -lc cat > /mnt/data/GMRI_GITHUB_LIBRARY_ONLY/acquire_everything.py <<'PY'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exact-scope acquisition: every listed GitHub repo mirror and Library export file.

Uses Git plumbing, source SHA hashes, and provenance-preserving importers. The
only remote endpoint used when --fetch-github is supplied is github.com. It
never deletes user-supplied sources or decides relevance from topic keywords.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse,json,os,re,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
from build_graph import GraphBuilder
from ingest_tree import index_tree
from ingest_git_history import ingest_git_history

REPO_RE=re.compile(r'^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$')


def repository_names(manifest_path:Path)->list[str]:
    raw=json.loads(Path(manifest_path).read_text('utf-8'))
    owner=raw['github']['owner']
    names=[f'{owner}/{a.strip()}' for a in raw['github']['repository_names'].split(';')]
    if any(not REPO_RE.fullmatch(name) or name.count('/')!=1 for name in names):
        raise ValueError('Unsafe or invalid GitHub repository identity')
    if len(names)!=len(set(names)):
        raise ValueError('Duplicate repository name (source inventory is inconsistent)')
    if len(names)!=raw['github']['metadata_count_seen']:
        raise ValueError('Repository count and inventory disagree')
    return names


def mirror_path(mirrors:Path,full_name:str)->Path:
    if not REPO_RE.fullmatch(full_name):raise ValueError('Unsafe GitHub repo name')
    return Path(mirrors)/(full_name.split('/')[1]+'.git')


def acquire_local_sources(db:Path,library_root:Path|None,mirrors:Path|None,names:list[str],namespace:str)->dict:
    b=GraphBuilder(db)
    receipt={'schema':'GMRI_GITHUB_AND_LIBRARY_ACQUISITION/1', 'source_scope':['GitHub','ChatGPT Library'],
             'library':None,'github':{'expected_repositories':len(names),'repositories_imported':0,
                                     'repos_missing':[],'commits':0,'blob_occurrences':0,'refs':0,
                                     'import_errors':[], 'per_repository':[]}}
    try:
        if library_root is not None:
            if not Path(library_root).is_dir():raise FileNotFoundError(f'Library export folder not found: {library_root}')
            receipt['library']=index_tree(b,Path(library_root),namespace+'-library')
        if mirrors is not None:
            for name in names:
                path=mirror_path(mirrors,name)
                if not path.is_dir() or not (path/'HEAD').exists():
                    receipt['github']['repos_missing'].append(name)
                    continue
                result=ingest_git_history(b,path,namespace+'-github',name)
                receipt['github']['repositories_imported']+=1
                receipt['github']['commits']+=result['commits']
                receipt['github']['blob_occurrences']+=result['blob_occurrences']
                receipt['github']['refs']+=result['refs']
                receipt['github']['import_errors'].extend(result['errors'])
                receipt['github']['per_repository'].append(result)
        receipt['integrity']=b.validate()
    finally:
        b.close()
    receipt['verified_all_requested_repos']=len(receipt['github']['repos_missing'])==0 and not receipt['github']['import_errors'] and receipt['github']['repositories_imported']==len(names)
    return receipt


def fetch_all_mirrors(mirrors:Path,names:list[str])->list[dict]:
    """Use credential helper or GitHub CLI authentication configured by user."""
    mirrors=Path(mirrors)
    mirrors.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    outcomes=[]
    env=dict(os.environ,GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0')
    for name in names:
        path=mirror_path(mirrors,name)
        url=f'https://github.com/{name}.git'
        if path.is_dir() and (path/'HEAD').is_file():
            command=['git','-C',str(path),'remote','update','--prune']
            mode='refresh_full_mirror'
        elif path.exists():
            outcomes.append({'repo':name,'state':'local_path_collision','path':str(path)})
            continue
        else:
            command=['git','clone','--mirror',url,str(path)]
            mode='clone_full_mirror'
        try:
            # Secrets are never included in the receipt or the invoked command.
            process=subprocess.run(command,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,env=env,timeout=1800)
            outcomes.append({'repo':name,'state':'ok' if process.returncode==0 else 'fetch_error',
                'operation':mode,'exit_code':process.returncode,
                'details':process.stderr[-1200:] if process.returncode else None})
        except Exception as exc:
            outcomes.append({'repo':name,'state':'fetch_error','operation':mode,'error':str(exc)[:500]})
    return outcomes


def main()->int:
    base=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Acquire every GitHub repository and every file from an original Library export')
    ap.add_argument('--library-export',type=Path,help='Root of the complete ORIGINAL ChatGPT Library file export')
    ap.add_argument('--git-mirrors',type=Path,help='Directory containing bare Git mirrors named <repo>.git')
    ap.add_argument('--fetch-github',action='store_true',help='Clone/refresh all 100 repos from GitHub; network and auth required')
    ap.add_argument('--db',type=Path,default=base/'GMRI_universal_stage1.sqlite')
    ap.add_argument('--namespace',default='github-library-universe')
    ap.add_argument('--receipt',type=Path,default=base/'ACQUISITION_RECEIPT.json')
    args=ap.parse_args()
    if args.fetch_github and not args.git_mirrors:ap.error('--fetch-github requires --git-mirrors')
    if args.library_export is None and args.git_mirrors is None:ap.error('Supply --library-export and/or --git-mirrors')
    names=repository_names(base/'connector_seed.json')
    external=[]
    if args.fetch_github:
        external=fetch_all_mirrors(args.git_mirrors,names)
    receipt=acquire_local_sources(args.db,args.library_export,args.git_mirrors,names,args.namespace)
    if args.fetch_github:receipt['remote_fetch']=external
    args.receipt.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    args.receipt.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({'library':receipt['library'],'github':{k:v for k,v in receipt['github'].items() if k!='per_repository'},
                      'verified_all_requested_repos':receipt['verified_all_requested_repos']},indent=2))
    if (receipt['library'] and receipt['library']['errors']) or receipt['github']['import_errors'] or (args.git_mirrors is not None and receipt['github']['repos_missing']):
        return 2
    if args.fetch_github and any(r['state']!='ok' for r in external):return 2
    return 0

if __name__=='__main__':sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Export the source graph to GraphML, CSV, JSON, and an offline interactive viewer."""
from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3,json,html,collections,csv,gzip,datetime as dt,hashlib,math,os,re,sys
from lxml import etree as ET
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DB=HERE/'GMRI_universal_stage1.sqlite'
if not DB.exists(): raise SystemExit('Run run_stage1.py first')
c=sqlite3.connect(DB)
c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
N=c.execute('select id,kind,label,body,source_id,event_ts,recorded_ts,metadata_json,layers from nodes order by rowid').fetchall()
E=c.execute('select src,dst,relation,source_id,evidence_state,metadata_json from edges order by id').fetchall()
mapidx={v['id']:i for i,v in enumerate(N)}
print('Loaded for export',len(N),'nodes',len(E),'edges',flush=True)
# GraphML: all node content, including original statement text and machine metadata.
ns='http://graphml.graphdrawing.org/xmlns'
KEYS={'k_type':('node','kind'),'k_label':('node','label'),'k_text':('node','body'),'k_source':('node','source_id'),
      'k_event':('node','event_ts'),'k_recorded':('node','recorded_ts'),'k_meta':('node','metadata_json'),
      'k_layers':('node','layers'),'e_rel':('edge','relation'),'e_state':('edge','evidence_state'),
      'e_source':('edge','source_id'),'e_meta':('edge','metadata_json')}
def xmlclean(t):
    if t is None:return ''
    return ''.join(ch for ch in str(t) if ch in '\t\n\r' or (0x20<=ord(ch)<=0xD7FF) or (0xE000<=ord(ch)<=0xFFFD) or 0x10000<=ord(ch)<=0x10FFFF)
with ET.xmlfile(str(HERE/'GMRI_universal_stage1.graphml'),encoding='utf-8') as xf:
    xf.write_declaration()
    with xf.element('{%s}graphml'%ns,nsmap={None:ns}):
        for key,(w,name) in KEYS.items():
            q=ET.Element('{%s}key'%ns,id=key);q.attrib['for']=w;q.attrib['attr.name']=name;q.attrib['attr.type']='string';xf.write(q)
        with xf.element('{%s}graph'%ns,id='GMRI_UNIVERSAL_2026_10_28',edgedefault='directed'):
            for r in N:
                with xf.element('{%s}node'%ns,id=r['id']):
                    for kid,col in [('k_type','kind'),('k_label','label'),('k_text','body'),('k_source','source_id'),('k_event','event_ts'),('k_recorded','recorded_ts'),('k_meta','metadata_json'),('k_layers','layers')]:
                        if r[col] is not None:
                            tag=ET.Element('{%s}data'%ns,key=kid);tag.text=xmlclean(r[col]);xf.write(tag)
            for i,r in enumerate(E):
                with xf.element('{%s}edge'%ns,id=f'e{i+1}',source=r['src'],target=r['dst']):
                    for kid,col in [('e_rel','relation'),('e_state','evidence_state'),('e_source','source_id'),('e_meta','metadata_json')]:
                        if r[col] is not None:
                            tag=ET.Element('{%s}data'%ns,key=kid);tag.text=xmlclean(r[col]);xf.write(tag)
print('GraphML exported',flush=True)
# Transparent exchange registers: no hidden weighting or excluded types.
with open(HERE/'node_register.csv','w',newline='',encoding='utf-8') as f:
 w=csv.writer(f);w.writerow(['id','kind','label','source_id','event_ts','recorded_ts','text_characters','layers'])
 for r in N:w.writerow([r['id'],r['kind'],r['label'],r['source_id'],r['event_ts'],r['recorded_ts'],len(r['body'] or ''),r['layers']])
with open(HERE/'edge_register.csv','w',newline='',encoding='utf-8') as f:
 w=csv.writer(f);w.writerow(['src','dst','relation','source_id','evidence_state','metadata_json'])
 for r in E:w.writerow([r['src'],r['dst'],r['relation'],r['source_id'],r['evidence_state'],r['metadata_json']])
with open(HERE/'source_manifest.csv','w',newline='',encoding='utf-8') as f:
 w=csv.writer(f);w.writerow(['id','path','sha256','bytes','mime','parse_status','parent_id','metadata_json'])
 for r in c.execute('select * from sources order by rowid'):w.writerow(list(r))
# JSON preserves all node bodies, registered edges, timestamps, provenance metadata.
node_out=[]
for r in N:
 node_out.append([r['id'],r['kind'],r['label'],r['body'] or '',r['source_id'],r['event_ts'],r['recorded_ts'],r['metadata_json'],r['layers']])
edge_out=[[mapidx[e['src']],mapidx[e['dst']],e['relation'],e['evidence_state'],e['source_id']] for e in E]
payload={'schema':'GMRI-4D-EVERYTHING/2.0-LOCAL','metadata':{'status':'all currently recovered text indexed; byte-level connectors remain provenance-gated',
 'counts':{'nodes':len(N),'edges':len(E)},'evidence_caution':'a lexical link is not causal proof','source':'local original source bytes, Library extracted text, legacy graph snapshots, Drive original file downloads, GitHub repository metadata'},
 'node_columns':['id','kind','label','body','source_id','event_ts','recorded_ts','metadata_json','layers'],
 'edge_columns':['src_node_index','dst_node_index','relation','evidence_state','source_id'],
 'nodes':node_out,'edges':edge_out}

import http.cookiejar,json,sqlite3,sys,threading,urllib.error,urllib.parse,urllib.request

def make_example_server(tmp_path):
    db=tmp_path/'test.db';b=GraphBuilder(db)
    a=b.source('a.md',b'This is all about neurodatabase and history.','text/markdown')
    b.ingest_text(a,'This is all about neurodatabase and history.')
    c=b.source('b.md',b'Another person reports a contradictory finding.','text/markdown')
    b.ingest_text(c,'Another person reports a contradictory finding.')

def test_explorer_requires_real_authentication_and_blocks_wrong_token(tmp_path):
    server,base,a,c=make_example_server(tmp_path)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/') as response:
            assert response.status==200
            assert 'html' in response.headers['Content-Type']
        try:
            urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/api/stats')
            assert False,'An unauthenticated visitor received private graph stats'
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:assert e.code==401
        request=urllib.request.Request(base+'/api/login',data=b'{"token":"wrong"}',headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'},method='POST')
        try:urllib.request.urlopen(request);assert False
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:assert e.code==403
    finally:server.shutdown();server.server_close()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""GMRI private, authenticated, paginated SQLite graph explorer server.

Standard library only. No external analytics, CDNs, upload, model or telemetry.
Default bind is loopback. Public/LAN bind requires HTTPS certificate.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

MIME={'/':'text/html; charset=utf-8','/app.js':'application/javascript; charset=utf-8','/style.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8'}

def _limit(q,key,default=50,maxval=500):
    try:v=int(q.get(key,[str(default)])[0])
    except (ValueError,TypeError):v=default
    return max(0,min(maxval,v))


def _connect(db):
    c=sqlite3.connect('file:'+str(Path(db).resolve())+'?mode=ro',uri=True,timeout=5)
    c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    c.execute('pragma query_only=ON')
    return c


def _parse(raw):
    try:return json.loads(raw) if raw else {}
    except ValueError:return {}


def _summary(r):
    return {'id':r['id'],'kind':r['kind'],'label':r['label'],'preview':r['preview'] or '',
            'source_id':r['source_id'],'event_ts':r['event_ts'],'recorded_ts':r['recorded_ts']}


def _get_stats(c):
    stats={k:c.execute('select count(*) from '+k).fetchone()[0] for k in ('nodes','edges','sources')}
    stats['dangling_edges']=c.execute('''select count(*) from edges e left join nodes a on e.src=a.id
    left join nodes b on e.dst=b.id where a.id is null or b.id is null''').fetchone()[0]
    stats['kinds']=[{'kind':k,'count':v} for k,v in c.execute('select kind,count(*) from nodes group by kind order by kind')]
    stats['evidence_states']=[{'state':k,'count':v} for k,v in c.execute('select evidence_state,count(*) from edges group by evidence_state order by count(*) desc')]
    return stats


def _search(c,q):
    terms=q.get('q',[''])[0].strip()
    if len(terms)>250:raise ValueError('Search term too long')
    kinds=q.get('kind',['all'])[0];basis=q.get('basis',['event'])[0]
    year=q.get('year',['all'])[0]
    if basis not in ('event','recorded'):raise ValueError('Time basis must be event or recorded')
    if year not in ('all','unknown') and not re.fullmatch(r'\d{4}',year):raise ValueError('Invalid year')
    lim=_limit(q,'limit',45,200);off=_limit(q,'offset',0,10_000_000)
    cond=[];values=[]
    clauses='FROM nodes n'
    # FTS indexes complete text and supplies a deterministic paginated result.
    tokens=re.findall(r'[^\W_]+',terms,flags=re.UNICODE)
    if terms and not tokens:return {'total':0,'offset':off,'limit':lim,'results':[]}
    if tokens:
        clauses+=' JOIN nodes_fts f ON f.node_id=n.id'
        cond.append('f.nodes_fts MATCH ?')
        values.append(' AND '.join('"'+t.replace('"','""')+'"' for t in tokens))
    if kinds!='all':cond.append('n.kind=?');values.append(kinds)
    tcol='n.event_ts' if basis=='event' else 'n.recorded_ts'
    if year=='unknown':cond.append(tcol+' IS NULL')
    elif year!='all':
        cond.append(tcol+'>=? AND '+tcol+'<?')
        # These bounds reflect UTC calendar years, not guessed local dates.
        import datetime as dt
        values.extend([dt.datetime(int(year),1,1,tzinfo=dt.timezone.utc).timestamp(),
                       dt.datetime(int(year)+1,1,1,tzinfo=dt.timezone.utc).timestamp()])
    where=' WHERE '+' AND '.join(cond) if cond else ''
    total=c.execute('SELECT count(*) '+clauses+where,values).fetchone()[0]
    rows=c.execute('''SELECT n.id,n.kind,n.label,substr(n.body,1,180) AS preview,
       n.source_id,n.event_ts,n.recorded_ts '''+clauses+where+' ORDER BY n.rowid LIMIT ? OFFSET ?',values+[lim,off]).fetchall()
    return {'total':total,'offset':off,'limit':lim,'results':[_summary(x) for x in rows]}


def _node(c,q):
    node_id=q.get('id',[''])[0]
    if not node_id or len(node_id)>500:raise ValueError('Provide a valid node ID')
    size=_limit(q,'body_limit',20000,100000);off=_limit(q,'body_offset',0,2_000_000_000)
    row=c.execute('''SELECT id,kind,label,source_id,event_ts,recorded_ts,metadata_json,layers,
    length(body) AS text_total_chars,substr(body,?,?) AS body FROM nodes WHERE id=?''',(off+1,size,node_id)).fetchone()
    if not row:return None
    result={k:row[k] for k in ('id','kind','label','source_id','event_ts','recorded_ts','text_total_chars','body')}
    result['body_offset']=off;result['body_limit']=size;result['has_more_text']=off+size<result['text_total_chars']
    result['metadata']=_parse(row['metadata_json']);result['layers']=_parse(row['layers'])
    sid=row['source_id']
    if sid:
        sr=c.execute('SELECT id,path,sha256,bytes,mime,parse_status,parent_id,metadata_json FROM sources WHERE id=?',(sid,)).fetchone()
        result['source']=({k:sr[k] for k in ('id','path','sha256','bytes','mime','parse_status','parent_id')}|{'metadata':_parse(sr['metadata_json'])}) if sr else {'reference_id':sid,'registered_source_record':False}
    return result

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent verification of exact GitHub+Library source boundary and graph."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse,gzip,json,sqlite3,hashlib
from pathlib import Path

P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def scope_receipt(db:Path,graph_gz:Path|None=None,inventory:dict|None=None)->dict:
    c=sqlite3.connect(db)
    c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    count=lambda sql:c.execute(sql).fetchone()[0]
    n=count('select count(*) from nodes');e=count('select count(*) from edges')
    sources=count('select count(*) from sources')
    library_ids=count("select count(distinct json_extract(metadata_json,'$.library_file_id')) from sources where path like 'library://%'")
    github_roots=count("select count(*) from nodes where kind='repository_metadata'")
    github_bytes=count("select count(*) from sources where path like 'githubconnector://%'")
    drive_sources=count("select count(*) from sources where path like 'drive://%' or path like '%google_drive%'")
    drive_nodes=count("select count(*) from nodes where kind like 'drive_%'")
    null_edges=count('select count(*) from edges e left join nodes n1 on e.src=n1.id left join nodes n2 on e.dst=n2.id where n1.id is null or n2.id is null')
    integrity=c.execute('pragma integrity_check').fetchone()[0]
    fts=count('select count(*) from nodes_fts')
    errors=count("select count(*) from events where event_kind like '%ingest_error%' or event_kind like '%read_error%'")
    lib_binary_count=count("select count(*) from sources where path like 'library://%' and json_extract(metadata_json,'$.original_byte_stream_present')=1")
    git_histories=count("select count(*) from nodes where kind='git_repository'")
    record={'schema':'GMRI_SOURCE_SCOPE_PROOF/1','authorized_sources':['GitHub','ChatGPT Library'],
        'node_count':n,'edge_count':e,'source_count':sources,
        'library_unique_text_extract_ids':library_ids,
        'library_original_binary_sources_recovered':lib_binary_count,
        'github_repository_metadata':github_roots,
        'github_verified_connector_file_bytes':github_bytes,
        'github_complete_local_mirrors_imported':git_histories,
        'drive_sources':drive_sources,'drive_nodes':drive_nodes,
        'dangling_edges':null_edges,'sqlite_integrity':integrity,'full_text_search_entries':fts,
        'ingest_events_marked_as_error':errors,'graph_snapshot_matches_database':None}
    if graph_gz and graph_gz.exists():
        with gzip.open(graph_gz,'rt',encoding='utf-8') as f:d=json.load(f)
        record['graph_snapshot_matches_database']=(len(d['nodes'])==n and len(d['edges'])==e)
    if inventory is not None:
        record['library_inventory_at_scan']=inventory
    record['scope_tests_pass']=(drive_sources==0 and drive_nodes==0 and github_roots==100 and integrity=='ok' and null_edges==0 and fts==n and record['graph_snapshot_matches_database'] is not False)
    record['complete_original_source_acquisition_proven']=(record['scope_tests_pass'] and lib_binary_count>0 and git_histories==100 and
        record['library_original_binary_sources_recovered'] == (inventory or {}).get('file_entries') and errors==0)
    c.close()
    return record


def main()->int:
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--db',type=Path,default=P/'GMRI_universal_stage1.sqlite')
    ap.add_argument('--json',type=Path,default=P/'SOURCE_SCOPE_VERIFICATION.json')
    opts=ap.parse_args()
    old=P/'LIBRARY_INVENTORY_RECEIPT.json'
    inventory=json.loads(old.read_text()) if old.exists() else None
    r=scope_receipt(opts.db,P/'GMRI_universal_stage1.json.gz',inventory)
    opts.json.write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(r,indent=2))
    return 0 if r['scope_tests_pass'] else 2

if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(main())

# GMRI | GitHub + ChatGPT Library | Private universal graph engine

**Governing source selection:** the complete ChatGPT Library and all GitHub repositories belonging to `oldmangrizzz`. Not a keyword shortlist. No Drive crawler or Drive-derived sources. User source content may itself mention Drive; such mentions do not expand authorized source access.

This deliverable is a working, inspectable, private graph engine and an acquisition pipeline with strict completion checks. `SOURCE_SCOPE_VERIFICATION.json` records exactly which bytes and identities have been acquired. An observed filename or URL is never treated as a substitute for original file content. Library text extracts are explicitly identified as extracted text, not the original file bytes. Historical graph relations are historical author claims, not proof of independent verification.

## Existing observed graph

Start with the archive's `WORKBENCH/` folder. The SQLite database contains indexed evidence, original historical conversation branches, 2026 conversations, original local sources, Library extracted records, the 100-repository GitHub inventory, SHA-verified GitHub tree material and the previous authored graph's nodes/edges. The graph's other formats are GraphML and gzip-compressed JSON. Original input files, Library text extracts, and the GitHub connector snapshot are included in separate folders.

## Browse it on the same computer

```bash
cd WORKBENCH
python3 server.py
```

Enter the generated access token in the website opened at `http://127.0.0.1:8765/` on **that computer**. The program uses Python's standard library to serve the searchable SQLite knowledge graph through a read-only, token-authenticated, paginated interface. It does not need network access, an account, external JavaScript libraries, or a model subscription. The visible graph is a bounded viewport; searching and paging can reach every indexed record. A real browser interaction test is still necessary before asserting cross-device usability; the graph's REST endpoints and UI structural contract have automated tests.

## Ingest all original ChatGPT Library bytes and 100 full GitHub histories

The source acquisition runner can ingest every file under an original Library export directory, including duplications, subfolders, hidden files, unknown binary formats, and nested archives. For GitHub it clones full bare mirrors and imports all reachable commits/branches/tags and file occurrences. It never selects sources for relevance.

```bash
cd WORKBENCH
python3 acquire_everything.py \
  --library-export /path/to/complete-original-ChatGPT-Library-export \
  --git-mirrors /path/to/private-GitHub-mirrors \
  --fetch-github
```

Authenticated GitHub access must already be set up on the computer (e.g. Git credential helper). The runner uses plain Git, no cloud AI service. 100 repositories are drawn from `connector_seed.json` and checked for duplicates/count mismatches. The `--fetch-github` option clones or refreshes those 100 mirrors; without it, the runner processes already-cloned mirrors. It writes `ACQUISITION_RECEIPT.json`, records errors individually, and exits unsuccessfully when any requested mirror is absent or a file import fails. The Library source path is an **original file export**, not the extracted text available from the connected indexed Library. Re-running incremental imports preserves identical-byte occurrences, changed versions, and SHA metadata.

Install `pymupdf` and `python-docx` to extract PDF and DOCX text from original files. Install `lxml` to regenerate GraphML with `python3 export_graph.py`. Without them, original file hashes and metadata can still be catalogued but semantic text extraction has explicit limits.

## Verification and evidence rules

```bash
python3 verify_source_scope.py
python3 -m pytest -q tests
```

- Explicit source-family allowlist is **GitHub and native ChatGPT Library only**; no Drive records in the active graph.
- An original binary needs its own byte hash; a search index or archive title alone does not prove possession.
- All 100 GitHub repository names are observed as metadata; complete histories require their Git object mirrors and verified import receipts.
- All Library entries count, including twins, branches, revisions, orphaned context, unrelated books, pictures, PDFs, ZIPs and creative material. File content acquisition is separately checked against the actual complete Library inventory.
- Lexical graph edges are labeled unverified matches; previous graph assertions remain attributed to their authors.
- The user has defined the source contract. Successful tests on existing sources establish correctness of the tested mechanisms, not a certificate of full-corpus ingestion.

**Privacy:** Archive contains user-supplied personal conversation material and should not be posted publicly. No private user content was sent to an unrequested service by this build.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Package exclusively the two authorized source families and private engine."""
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib,json,zipfile
from pathlib import Path

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT=HERE.parent
OUT=ROOT/'GMRI_GITHUB_LIBRARY_ONLY_2026-10-28.zip'
PRIOR=ROOT/'GMRI_UNIVERSAL_EVERYTHING_STAGE1_2026-10-28.zip'


def digest(data:bytes)->str:return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def build():
    source=HERE
    chosen=[
     'GMRI_universal_stage1.sqlite','GMRI_universal_stage1.graphml','GMRI_universal_stage1.json.gz',
     'node_register.csv','edge_register.csv','source_manifest.csv',
     'build_graph.py','ingest_tree.py','ingest_git_history.py','ingest_github_snapshot.py',
     'merge_connected_sources.py','ingest_authorized.py','acquire_everything.py',
     'export_graph.py','search_graph.py','server.py','explorer.html','app.js','style.css',
     'README_GITHUB_LIBRARY_ONLY.md','CURRENT_SCOPE.md','SOURCE_SCOPE_VERIFICATION.json',
     'LIBRARY_INVENTORY_RECEIPT.json','connector_seed.json','GITHUB_TONYAI_TREE_RECEIPT.json',
     'AUTHORIZED_INGEST_RECEIPT.json','verify_source_scope.py','package_authorized.py'
    ]
    chosen+=sorted('tests/'+p.name for p in (HERE/'tests').glob('test_*.py'))
    chosen+=sorted('work/github_tonyai/'+p.relative_to(HERE/'work/github_tonyai').as_posix()
                   for p in (HERE/'work/github_tonyai').rglob('*') if p.is_file())
    original_manifest={}
    entry_hashes={}
    text_files=[]
    for folder in ('all','fullscan','prior-graphs'):
        directory=ROOT/'GMRI_LIBRARY_ACQUISITION'/folder
        if directory.exists():
            text_files.extend((f, f'LIBRARY_EXTRACTS/{folder}/'+f.relative_to(directory).as_posix())
               for f in directory.rglob('*.txt') if f.is_file())
    with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT,'w',compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=1,allowZip64=True) as z:
        for name in chosen:
            p=source/name
            if not p.is_file():raise FileNotFoundError('Release input missing: '+str(p))
            z.write(p,'WORKBENCH/'+name)
            with p.open('rb') as f:entry_hashes['WORKBENCH/'+name]=hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
        for p,entry in text_files:
            z.write(p,entry)
            with p.open('rb') as f:entry_hashes[entry]=hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
        with zipfile.ZipFile(PRIOR) as prior:
            for name in sorted(n for n in prior.namelist() if n.startswith('ORIGINALS/') and not n.endswith('/')):
                content=prior.read(name)
                original_manifest[name[len('ORIGINALS/'):]]=digest(content)
                z.writestr(name,content)
                entry_hashes[name]=digest(content)
        z.writestr('ORIGINALS_SHA256_MANIFEST.json',json.dumps(original_manifest,indent=2)+'\n')
        z.writestr('ENTRY_SHA256_MANIFEST.json',json.dumps(entry_hashes,indent=2)+'\n')
    receipt={'release_file':OUT.name,'archive_bytes':OUT.stat().st_size,
        'sha256':hashlib.file_digest(OUT.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest(),
        'original_source_files_preserved':len(original_manifest),
        'library_text_extraction_artifacts_included':len(text_files),
        'workbench_files_included':len(chosen),
        'source_scope':['GitHub','ChatGPT Library'],
        'no_unrequested_drive_source_bytes':True}
    (ROOT/'GMRI_GITHUB_LIBRARY_ONLY_RELEASE_RECEIPT.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':build()
