#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Make a self-contained, source-checksummed private GMRI research workbench ZIP."""
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib,json,zipfile
from pathlib import Path

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
WORK_FILES=[
 'GMRI_universal_stage1.sqlite','GMRI_universal_stage1.graphml','GMRI_universal_stage1.json.gz',
 'GMRI_Offline_4D_Explorer.html','node_register.csv','edge_register.csv','source_manifest.csv',
 'COVERAGE_LEDGER.json','CURRENT_SCOPE.md','DRIVE_RECEIPTS.json','connector_seed.json',
 'GMRI_schema_overview.mmd','START_HERE_V2.md','VERIFICATION_RECEIPT.json',
 'explorer.html','app.js','style.css','server.py','search_graph.py','build_graph.py',
 'merge_connected_sources.py','ingest_drive_downloads.py','ingest_tree.py','ingest_git_history.py',
 'rebuild_coverage.py','run_stage1.py','export_graph.py','browser_smoke.py',
 'tests/test_graph.py','tests/test_drive_import.py','tests/test_legacy_import.py',
 'tests/test_recursive_import.py','tests/test_git_history.py','tests/test_server.py',
 'tests/test_connected_explorer.py','tests/test_static_viewer.py','tests/test_release_package.py',
 'work/BROWSER_TEST_RESULT.json',
]

def _sha_file(path):
    with open(path,'rb') as handle:
        return hashlib.file_digest(handle,'sha256').hexdigest()


def make_release(workdir:Path,extracted_dir:Path,previous_archive:Path,drive_root:Path,output:Path,
                 work_files:list[str],drive_records:list[dict])->dict:
    workdir=Path(workdir);extracted_dir=Path(extracted_dir)
    output=Path(output);output.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    manifest=[];sizes={};counts={'workbench':0,'previous_originals':0,'library_extracts':0,'drive_originals':0}
    def record(path,size,digest,role,origin):
        manifest.append({'archive_path':path,'size':size,'sha256':digest,'role':role,'original_source_reference':origin})
        sizes[role]=sizes.get(role,0)+size
    with zipfile.ZipFile(output,'w',compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=6,allowZip64=True) as out:
        for relative in work_files:
            p=workdir/relative
            if not p.is_file():raise FileNotFoundError(f'Missing required workbench file: {p}')
            arc='WORKBENCH/'+relative.replace('\\','/')
            out.write(p,arc)
            record(arc,p.stat().st_size,_sha_file(p),'workbench',relative)
            counts['workbench']+=1
            print('Added workbench',relative,flush=True)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(previous_archive) as src:
            originals=[i for i in src.infolist() if i.filename.startswith('ORIGINALS/') and not i.is_dir()]
            if not originals:raise ValueError('Previous archive holds no ORIGINALS entries')
            for item in originals:
                data=src.read(item)
                arc=item.filename
                out.writestr(arc,data)
                record(arc,len(data),hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'original_stage1_bytes','stage1_zip:'+item.filename)
                counts['previous_originals']+=1
        for p in sorted(extracted_dir.rglob('*')):
            if not p.is_file():continue
            rel=p.relative_to(extracted_dir).as_posix()
            arc='LIBRARY_EXTRACTS/'+rel
            out.write(p,arc)
            record(arc,p.stat().st_size,_sha_file(p),'library_indexed_text_representation',rel)
            counts['library_extracts']+=1
        for item in drive_records:
            p=Path(drive_root)/item['mounted_as']
            if not p.exists():raise FileNotFoundError('Missing original Drive download: '+str(p))
            arc='DRIVE_ORIGINALS/'+item['id']+'__'+item['mounted_as']
            out.write(p,arc)
            record(arc,p.stat().st_size,_sha_file(p),'original_drive_bytes','drive:'+item['id']+'/'+item['name'])
            counts['drive_originals']+=1
        content={'schema':'GMRI_PRIVATE_SOURCE_PACKAGE_V2','files':manifest,'totals':counts,
          'evidence_terms':{'original_stage1_bytes':'SHA256 of original binary bytes in stage1 zip',
            'original_drive_bytes':'SHA256 of original bytes downloaded via Drive connector',
            'library_indexed_text_representation':'SHA256 only of extracted text, NOT original Library files'},
          'receipt_principle':'The package manifest is evidence for entries carried inside this archive only.'}
        out.writestr('MANIFEST_CONTENT.json',json.dumps(content,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False).encode())
        out.writestr('SHA256SUMS.txt',('\n'.join(f"{f['sha256']}  {f['archive_path']}" for f in manifest)+'\n').encode())
    summary={'archive':str(output),'archive_size_bytes':output.stat().st_size,
             'source_files_inside_archive':len(manifest),
             'original_file_count':counts['previous_originals'],
             'drive_original_bytes_count':counts['drive_originals'],
             'library_extract_count':counts['library_extracts'],
             'workbench_files_count':counts['workbench'],
             'sha256':_sha_file(output),
             'uncompressed_bytes_by_role':sizes}
    return summary


def main():
    here=HERE

    print('RELEASE',json.dumps(result,indent=2))

import { PersonalityCore } from './personality_core';
import { DialogueManager } from './dialogue_manager';
import { EmotionalIntelligence } from './emotional_intelligence';
import { AdaptiveLearning } from './adaptive_learning';
import { MemoryBank } from './memory_bank';
import { BehaviorModel } from './behavior_model';

export interface PersonalityTrait {
    confidence: number;
    wit: number;
    intellect: number;
    charm: number;
    emotionalDepth: number;
}

export type Behavior = 'aggressive' | 'friendly' | 'neutral' | 'casual' | 'serious' | 'playful' | 'sarcastic';

export interface Emotion {
    type: 'happy' | 'sad' | 'angry' | 'neutral';
    intensity: number;
}

export class TonyStarkAICore {
    private personalityCore: PersonalityCore;
    private dialogueManager: DialogueManager;
    private behaviorModel: BehaviorModel;
    private emotionalIntelligence: EmotionalIntelligence;
    private adaptiveLearning: AdaptiveLearning;
    private memoryBank: MemoryBank;

    constructor() {
        this.personalityCore = new PersonalityCore();
        this.dialogueManager = new DialogueManager();
        this.emotionalIntelligence = new EmotionalIntelligence();
        this.adaptiveLearning = new AdaptiveLearning();
        this.behaviorModel = new BehaviorModel();
        this.memoryBank = new MemoryBank();
    }

    processInput(input: string): string {
        const emotion = this.emotionalIntelligence.analyzeEmotion(input);
        const context = this.adaptiveLearning.getContext(input);
        const relevantMemories = this.memoryBank.retrieveRelevantMemories(input);

        const baseResponse = this.dialogueManager.generateResponse(input, emotion, context, relevantMemories);
        const behavior = this.behaviorModel.determineBehavior(baseResponse, emotion);
        const personalizedResponse = this.personalityCore.applyPersonality(baseResponse, behavior);

        this.memoryBank.storeInteraction(input, personalizedResponse);
        
        return this.addNonverbalCues(personalizedResponse, behavior);
    }

    private addNonverbalCues(response: string, behavior: Behavior): string {
        const cues = this.behaviorModel.generateNonverbalCues(behavior);
        return `${cues.before} ${response} ${cues.after}`;
    }
}

bash -lc cat > /mnt/data/GMRI_UNIVERSAL_GRAPH_STAGE1/ingest_github_snapshot.py <<'PY'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Ingest an authenticated GitHub connector tree snapshot with exact blob hashes.

A default-branch snapshot is not confused with a full repository history.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib,json,mimetypes
from pathlib import Path
from build_graph import GraphBuilder,stable_id


def _git_blob_sha(data:bytes)->str:
    return hashlib.sha1(f'blob {len(data)}\0'.encode('ascii')+data).hexdigest()


def ingest_tree_snapshot(b:GraphBuilder,manifest:dict,content_root:Path)->dict:
    repo=str(manifest['repo']);ref=str(manifest['ref'])
    tree_id=stable_id('github_connector_tree',repo,ref,manifest.get('tree_sha',''))
    repo_id=stable_id('repository',repo.partition('/')[0],repo.partition('/')[2])
    if not b.con.execute('SELECT 1 FROM nodes WHERE id=?',(repo_id,)).fetchone():
        b.node(repo_id,'repository_metadata',repo,metadata={'metadata_source':'connector_tree_snapshot'},layers=['source','context','junk_drawer'])
    b.node(tree_id,'git_tree_snapshot',repo+'@'+ref,metadata={
        'tree_sha':manifest.get('tree_sha'),'provider':manifest.get('provider'),
        'tree_truncated':manifest.get('tree_truncated'),
        'file_count_as_returned':len(manifest['files']),
        'semantics':'one observed tree snapshot, not a commit history'},layers=['source','timeline','junk_drawer'])
    b.edge(repo_id,tree_id,'HAS_GITHUB_TREE_SNAPSHOT',tree_id,'provider_observed')
    results={'tree':repo+'@'+ref,'file_entries':len(manifest['files']),'files_registered':0,
             'blob_sha_valid':0,'empty_blobs':0,'already_ingested':0,'errors':[]}
    for item in manifest['files']:
        rel=str(item['path'])
        if '..' in Path(rel).parts or Path(rel).is_absolute():
            raise ValueError('Git tree includes unsafe path')
        path=Path(content_root)/rel
        if item['size']==0 and not path.exists():data=b''
        elif path.is_file():data=path.read_bytes()
        else:
            results['errors'].append({'path':rel,'error':'contents not available from provider'})
            continue
        got=_git_blob_sha(data)
        if len(data)!=item['size'] or got!=item['git_blob_sha']:
            results['errors'].append({'path':rel,'error':'Git blob SHA or size mismatch','observed_sha':got})
            continue
        results['blob_sha_valid']+=1
        if not data:results['empty_blobs']+=1
        origin=f'githubconnector://{repo}/{ref}/{rel}'
        prev=b.con.execute('SELECT sha256 FROM sources WHERE path=?',(origin,)).fetchone()
        if prev:
            results['already_ingested']+=1;continue
        sid=b.source(origin,data,mimetypes.guess_type(rel)[0] or 'application/octet-stream',
            metadata={'original_byte_stream_present':True,'provider':'authenticated_GitHub_connector',
                'repo':repo,'ref':ref,'path':rel,'git_blob_sha':got,
                'git_blob_sha1_verified_locally':True,'tree_sha':manifest.get('tree_sha'),
                'file_mode':item.get('mode'),'source_kind':'single_tree_snapshot'})
        b.ingest_file_bytes(sid,data,rel)
        b.edge(tree_id,sid,'TREE_CONTAINS_FILE',tree_id,'provider_observed_git_sha_verified',
            {'git_blob_sha':got,'path':rel,'size':len(data)})
        results['files_registered']+=1
    b.con.commit()
    return results


if __name__=='__main__':
    here=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    b=GraphBuilder(here/'GMRI_universal_stage1.sqlite')
    manifest=json.loads((here/'GITHUB_TONYAI_TREE_RECEIPT.json').read_text())
    result=ingest_tree_snapshot(b,manifest,here/'work/github_tonyai')
    print(json.dumps({'result':result,'validation':b.validate()},indent=2))
    b.close()

# GMRI — EVERYTHING 4D Private Research Workbench

**Built 2026-10-28.** The release contains its evidence graph, live local explorer, complete available original source attachments, connected Library text extracts, verified Drive downloads, a verified GitHub tree snapshot, original graph author assertions, and reproducible source-handling code.

## Run the working research environment

1. Unzip the release; open a terminal in `WORKBENCH/`.
2. Run `python3 server.py`. Python 3.10+ with built-in `sqlite3` suffices to **browse** the completed database, with no cloud connection or third-party packages.
3. Copy the randomly generated **ACCESS TOKEN** shown in that terminal.
4. Open `http://127.0.0.1:8765/` **on that same computer** and enter the token.
5. Search or browse the unfiltered drawer; open a source, view all text in 20,000-character pages, inspect edges and original identities, compare event time with recorded time, trace recorded paths, use fishbone categories, or export Mermaid.

The explorer never requests an external API, and the local server listens only on loopback by default. Browsing works offline. Large sources are served on demand rather than embedded in a huge page. The `GMRI_Offline_4D_Explorer.html` is also included as an entirely self-contained offline snapshot, but the server workbench is the preferred iPad-responsive interface.

For access from an iPad rather than the same computer, expose the server only on a private network **with real TLS**: e.g., `python3 server.py --host 0.0.0.0 --tls-cert /path/to/certificate.pem --tls-key /path/to/key.pem`, and restrict access to your private network, using a hostname and certificate trusted by the iPad. The server rejects non-loopback binding without TLS. This release does not install a service, create trusted certificates, or configure remote access on your Mac. Never publish the bundle or disable authentication to make iPad access easier.

## What the archive contains

- `WORKBENCH/GMRI_universal_stage1.sqlite` — full-text FTS5 source graph, messages, original graph claim nodes, event and record time, evidence-state edges, source register. The `stage1` basename remains for **incremental database compatibility**; the contents have been extended by the v2 import.
- `WORKBENCH/explorer.html`, `app.js`, `style.css`, `server.py` — private searchable 4D web explorer with authentication and paginated source bodies.
- `WORKBENCH/GMRI_universal_stage1.graphml` and `.json.gz` — directed graph exchange formats; full node text and source IDs, not only labels.
- `WORKBENCH/GMRI_Offline_4D_Explorer.html` — self-contained read-only standalone visualization.
- `WORKBENCH/edge_register.csv`, `node_register.csv`, `source_manifest.csv` — inspectable machine-readable registers.
- `ORIGINALS/` — **32 byte-for-byte originals** from the initial mounted-source archive, including the 2023 and 2024 chat export ZIPs and complete 2026 JSON transcripts.
- `DRIVE_ORIGINALS/` — **16 exact downloaded non-native Drive files**, prefixed with their stable provider IDs.
- `LIBRARY_EXTRACTS/` — **116 extraction artifacts from 86 unique Library identities** (duplicate extraction captures retained). These are *indexed text representations*, not original Library binary copies.
- `GITHUB_SOURCE_TREE/` — two SHA1-verified non-empty files fetched from the TonyAI `main` tree. The other six files in that tree are zero-byte blobs, verified by their standard Git empty-blob SHA and represented in the graph. This is one branch snapshot, not the complete history of the other 99 repos.
- `MANIFEST_CONTENT.json`, `SHA256SUMS.txt` — archive-entry digests; `WORKBENCH/COVERAGE_LEDGER.json` is the current reproducible completion ledger.
- `WORKBENCH/VERIFICATION_RECEIPT.json` — tests and independent graph reconciliation.

All 2,575 Library entries were inventoried by the connector; only 86 unique source identities yielded text extracts into this runtime. The archive does **not** assert possession of the other original Library bytes. Source access denials and external connector limitations cannot be treated as evidence that a source does not exist. The live Google Drive crawl and complete Git histories have not been fully transferred. `COVERAGE_LEDGER.json` states the exact unclosed gates in one machine-readable place.

## Extend with complete original exports without changing the evidence standard

The intake is *not* dependent on topic keywords, relevance ratings, or the author's current argument. It registers **everything** under an explicitly supplied folder, including duplicates and apparently tangential files. In the unpacked `WORKBENCH/` directory:

```bash
# Entire ChatGPT Library export directory, with all original bytes included.
python3 ingest_tree.py --directory /path/to/complete-Library-export --namespace library-export-2026-10-28

# Entire Drive download/export directory; preserve filenames and byte-identical originals.
python3 ingest_tree.py --directory /path/to/full-Drive-export --namespace drive-export-2026-10-28

# Complete local Git clone/mirror for every repository, including reachable commit snapshots.
python3 ingest_git_history.py --repository /path/to/oldmangrizzz/some-repo --repo-full-name oldmangrizzz/some-repo --namespace github-full-history

# If files have been added, update source and alternate formats (lxml required for GraphML):
python3 rebuild_coverage.py
python3 export_graph.py
```

For **bulk ingestion** (rather than browsing), install `pymupdf` for PDFs, `python-docx` for Word documents, and `lxml` for GraphML exports. Python, Git and sufficient disk space are required. Do **not** treat a package whose importer reported errors or missing source entries as complete. For repeated ingests, source identity + SHA protect idempotency and preserve changed versions; a same-named file with different content is a distinct version that needs investigation.

Source classification rules: original bytes are checksummed as bytes; Library extraction is checksummed **as extraction**, not misrepresented as a raw original; metadata-only GitHub inventory does not imply code review; historical graph “verified” labels remain attributed to the original graph author; lexical links are navigation, not causal conclusions. Two different timestamps, **when the event happened** and **when the record was recorded/exported**, remain distinct. FTS indexes the entire available extracted text, not a curated paragraph list.

## Verification and acceptance

Automated suite: **31 tests** as of this release (source and archive idempotence, exact Git blob hash, nested ZIPs, malformed login requests, source-page retrieval, temporal filters, original binary retention, existing graph merge, schema and view contract). SQLite integrity and GraphML-to-SQL counts are separately reconciled in `VERIFICATION_RECEIPT.json`. The available Chromium runtime was blocked by administrator policy from navigating even to localhost, so there is no fabricated browser clickthrough PASS. A live HTTP/API call path was exercised through Python's standard-library client instead.

**Acceptance definition:** all source identities discovered, all authorized original bytes acquired, all recovered text/relations indexed, each edge source state documented, zero unaccounted extraction errors, reproducible graph integrity and UI runtime acceptance. The build carries a machine-readable ledger of which of these conditions it has actually proved.

def test_changed_original_bytes_preserve_old_and_new_versions_at_identical_path(tmp_path):
    d=tmp_path/'snapshot';d.mkdir()
    src=d/'thought.md';src.write_bytes(b'first thought')
    b=GraphBuilder(tmp_path/'db.sqlite')
    index_tree(b,d,namespace='versioned')
    src.write_bytes(b'corrected thought')
    index_tree(b,d,namespace='versioned')
    b.close()
    with sqlite3.connect(tmp_path/'db.sqlite') as c:

def test_two_git_tree_versions_remain_distinct_on_default_branch(tmp_path):
    file=tmp_path/'main.py';file.write_bytes(b'earlier version')

    def snapshot(tree,data):

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent, local, machine-readable validation of the GMRI evidence graph."""
import csv,gzip,json,hashlib,re,sqlite3,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
from lxml import etree

P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def count_csv(name):
    with open(P/name,'r',encoding='utf-8',newline='') as f:
        next(csv.reader(f))
        return sum(1 for _ in csv.reader(f))

def main():
    tests=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pytest','-q'],cwd=P,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
    result={'schema':'GMRI_RELEASE_VERIFICATION/2','date':'2026-10-28',
       'automated_suite':{'returncode':tests.returncode,'last_output':tests.stdout.strip()[-1000:],
                           'stderr':tests.stderr.strip()[-1000:]},
       'checks':{},'accepted_local_integrity':False,'full_universe_accepted':False}
    c=sqlite3.connect(P/'GMRI_universal_stage1.sqlite')
    n=c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM nodes').fetchone()[0]
    e=c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM edges').fetchone()[0]
    s=c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM sources').fetchone()[0]
    integrity=c.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0]
    fts=c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM nodes_fts').fetchone()[0]
    dangling=c.execute('''SELECT count(*) FROM edges e LEFT JOIN nodes a ON a.id=e.src LEFT JOIN nodes b ON b.id=e.dst
            WHERE a.id IS NULL OR b.id IS NULL''').fetchone()[0]
    c.close()
    xnodes=xedges=0;ns='{http://graphml.graphdrawing.org/xmlns}'
    for _,el in etree.iterparse(str(P/'GMRI_universal_stage1.graphml'),events=('end',),
                                tag=(ns+'node',ns+'edge'),huge_tree=True):
        if el.tag.endswith('node'):xnodes+=1
        else:xedges+=1
        el.clear()
    with gzip.open(P/'GMRI_universal_stage1.json.gz','rb') as f:
        import orjson
        data=orjson.loads(f.read())
    bytejs=subprocess.run(['node','--check',str(P/'app.js')],capture_output=True,text=True)
    importdocs=json.loads((P/'GITHUB_TONYAI_TREE_RECEIPT.json').read_text('utf-8'))
    countgit=0;gitfail=[]
    for item in importdocs['files']:
        path=P/'work/github_tonyai'/item['path']
        contents=path.read_bytes() if path.exists() else b''
        sha=hashlib.sha1(f'blob {len(contents)}\0'.encode('ascii')+contents).hexdigest()
        if len(contents)!=item['size'] or sha!=item['git_blob_sha']:
            gitfail.append(item['path'])
        else:countgit+=1
    result['checks']={
      'sqlite_integrity':integrity,
      'node_count':n,'edge_count':e,'source_count':s,'fts_indexed_nodes':fts,
      'dangling_edge_endpoints':dangling,'graphml_node_count':xnodes,'graphml_edge_count':xedges,
      'json_node_count':len(data['nodes']),'json_edge_count':len(data['edges']),
      'csv_node_count':count_csv('node_register.csv'),
      'csv_edge_count':count_csv('edge_register.csv'),
      'csv_source_count':count_csv('source_manifest.csv'),
      'js_syntax_check_returncode':bytejs.returncode,
      'github_tonyai_sha1_blob_matches':countgit,'github_tonyai_mismatched_blobs':gitfail,
      'checks_are_exact_not_estimated':True}
    result['browser_runtime']=json.loads((P/'work/BROWSER_TEST_RESULT.json').read_text('utf-8'))
    result['accepted_local_integrity']=(tests.returncode==0 and integrity=='ok' and
        fts==xnodes==len(data['nodes'])==result['checks']['csv_node_count']==n and
        xedges==len(data['edges'])==result['checks']['csv_edge_count']==e and
        s==result['checks']['csv_source_count'] and dangling==0 and bytejs.returncode==0 and countgit==8)
    result['full_universe_accepted']=False
    result['external_source_acquisition_gates']=json.loads((P/'COVERAGE_LEDGER.json').read_text('utf-8'))['readiness_gates']
    (P/'VERIFICATION_RECEIPT.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({'accepted_local_integrity':result['accepted_local_integrity'],
                      'tests':result['automated_suite']['last_output'],
                      'nodes':n,'edges':e,'sources':s,'json_and_graphml_match':n==xnodes==len(data['nodes']) and e==xedges==len(data['edges']),
                      'github_verified_blobs':countgit},indent=2))
    if not result['accepted_local_integrity']:raise SystemExit(2)

if __name__=='__main__':main()

def test_local_model_serves_distinct_personas_without_fake_verification(tmp_path):
    observed=[]
    class LocalInference(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def log_message(self,*args):pass
        def do_POST(self):
            size=int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0'))
            req=json.loads(self.rfile.read(size))
            observed.append(req['messages'])
            body=json.dumps({'choices':[{'message':{'content':json.dumps({'summary':'Source evaluation, no independent corroboration','citations':['N1'],'state':'HYPOTHESIS'})}}]}).encode()
            self.send_response(200);self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json');self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(body)));self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(body)
    s=ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),LocalInference)
    thread=threading.Thread(target=s.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
    try:
        graph=tmp_path/'evidence.sqlite';graph_db(graph)
        m=OpenAICompatibleModel('http://127.0.0.1:'+str(s.server_port)+'/v1','fixture-local')
        runtime=Runtime(tmp_path/'state',graph,model=m)
        result=runtime.mission('Clinical orientation','live')
        assert len(observed)==6
        assert result['dottie_finding']['evidence_mode']=='model_generated_unverified'
        assert all(x['evidence_mode']=='model_generated_unverified' for x in result['findings'].values())
        assert all(x['model_name']=='fixture-local' for x in result['findings'].values())
        assert all(x['source_refs']==['N1'] for x in result['findings'].values())
        assert len({x[0]['content'] for x in observed})==6
        assert all('Clinical orientation' in x[-1]['content'] for x in observed)
        assert result['original_question']=='Clinical orientation'
    finally:
        s.shutdown();s.server_close();thread.join(3)


def test_http_redirect_to_remote_provider_is_not_followed(tmp_path):
    class LocalRedirect(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def log_message(self,*args):pass
        def do_POST(self):
            self.send_response(302)
            self.send_header('Location','https://external.example/steal')
            self.end_headers()
    s=ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),LocalRedirect)
    thread=threading.Thread(target=s.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
    try:
        m=OpenAICompatibleModel('http://127.0.0.1:'+str(s.server_port)+'/v1','model')
        with pytest.raises(ModelError) as e:m.generate('system','user',[])
        assert 'unavailable' in str(e.value).lower()
    finally:s.shutdown();s.server_close();thread.join(3)

def test_agent_veto_places_mission_on_hold(tmp_path):

        model_name='dissenting-simulation'

def test_orientation_changes_next_observation_candidates_after_feedback(tmp_path):
    from ooda_layers import orientation_targets
    db=setup(tmp_path)
    cid=start_cycle(db,'a','Look for recursive effects','investigator')
    obs=observe(db,cid,'a','investigator')
    orient(db,cid,'Initial model','dottie',[obs])
    before=orientation_targets(db,cid)
    assert {'b','d'} <= {x['proposition_id'] for x in before['candidates']}
    observed=observe(db,cid,'d','investigator')
    orient(db,cid,'Reorient toward the environmental consequence','dottie',[observed])
    after=orientation_targets(db,cid)
    assert 'd' not in {x['proposition_id'] for x in after['candidates']}
    assert 'c' in {x['proposition_id'] for x in after['candidates']}
    assert after['orientation_version']==2
    assert after['observation_inputs'] != before['observation_inputs']


def test_any_full_archive_node_can_be_observed_without_promoting_interpretation(tmp_path):
    from ooda_layers import observe_archive_node,unified_view
    import hashlib
    db=setup(tmp_path)
    base=tmp_path/'source.sqlite'
    with sqlite3.connect(base) as c:
        c.execute('CREATE TABLE nodes(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,kind TEXT,label TEXT,body TEXT,source_id TEXT,metadata_json TEXT)')
        c.execute('INSERT INTO nodes VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)',('raw:1','message_export','User source','verbatim archival text','original','{"role":"user","event_at":"2023-11-19T01:23:00+00:00"}'))
    with sqlite3.connect(db) as c:
        c.execute('UPDATE universe_node SET body_sha256=? WHERE node_id=?',(hashlib.sha256(b'verbatim archival text').hexdigest(),'raw:1'))
    cid=start_cycle(db,'a','Cross-reference every archival record','investigator')
    eid,claim=observe_archive_node(db,cid,'raw:1','investigator',base)
    rec=cycle_history(db,cid)[-1]
    assert rec['id']==eid
    assert rec['source_trace']['verbatim']=='verbatim archival text'
    assert rec['source_trace']['state']=='NOT_ASSESSED'
    assert rec['source_trace']['base_node']=='raw:1'
    view=unified_view(db,claim,base_db=base)

def ingest(db):
    for source_id,original,claims in DIRECT:
        add_source(db,source_id,'user','verbatim_current_conversation',original,
          'active_conversation:2026-10-29:'+hashlib.sha256(original.encode()).hexdigest()[:20],
          recorded_at='2026-10-29')
        for pid,quote in claims:
            add_claim(db,pid,source_id,quote,'INVESTIGATOR_REPORTED',
                      'Verbatim. Attributed assertion; not automatically independently verified.')
    add_relation(db,'user:not-listening','user:substituted-inference',
      'SUPPORTS_CANDIDATE',
      'Operator explicitly linked these two statements with the word Therefore in the source; this records operator attribution, not independently proven causation.',
      'explicit')
    return {'source_entries':len(DIRECT),'verbatim_propositions':sum(len(x[2]) for x in DIRECT),
            'directly_attributed_links':1}

bash -lc cat > /mnt/data/GMRI_ASSISTANT_BRIDGE/README_FOR_ASSISTANTS.md <<'EOF'
# GMRI | Assistant-facing reasoning bridge

**Primary client: the assistant making an answer**, not a human browsing a visualization.

This private bundle gives a local agent a read-only MCP server that can retrieve exact user-authored instructions, source-backed propositions, assessed graph relationships, original source receipts, and bounded OODA investigation targets. It never silently turns co-occurrence or archive adjacency into causal proof.

## How an assistant uses it

The model/client must attach the local MCP server to its available tools. In the extracted bundle root, run `./START_GMRI_ASSISTANT_MCP.sh`. The server uses newline-framed MCP JSON-RPC over standard input/output. No external network service is started.

The assistant uses the tools in this order when handling a GMRI research or engineering question:

1. `gmri_bootstrap` to recover the exact governing user statements and their source hashes. Do not rewrite their intent.
2. `gmri_context` with the user's actual question to retrieve source-grounded propositions and assessed warrants. Treat lexical archive hits only as navigation candidates.
3. `gmri_get_record` when the answer depends on a quoted original, archived message, historic branch, or source SHA-256. Follow offsets until the relevant evidence is present.
4. `gmri_trace` to investigate explicit paths and cycles. Never claim a hypothetical edge has been empirically verified.
5. `gmri_ooda_targets` when examining an already recorded OODA cycle. No execution authority is provided.
6. `gmri_scope_status` to check exactly how much source information and semantic interpretation is present before asserting coverage.

**Answer contract:** Cite/reproduce the retrieved user's exact statement before interpreting it. Label propositions by their actual source and evidence status. No claim that the 25,100 archive records have all been semantically analyzed: the original interpretation layer contained 21 explicitly assessed propositions before current-chat exact statements were added. A semantic relation must carry an explicit, inspectable warrant. When an answer is absent from the evidence, report that absence rather than inventing a preferred interpretation.

The full source-record retrieval is read-only. The user statements incorporated on October 29 are verbatim and carry per-document SHA-256. The only additional interstatement relation is directly attributable to the operator's own "Therefore" assertion, not independently established causation.

## Local CLI (does not require MCP installation)

From the extracted folder:

```sh
cd GMRI_REASONING_RECONSTRUCTION_2026-10-29
python3 assistant_bridge.py --graph GMRI_recurrent_reasoning_overlay.sqlite --archive ../GMRI_GITHUB_LIBRARY_ONLY/GMRI_universal_stage1.sqlite "Why was the graph created?"
```

Use `--status` to print scoped source counts and explicitly distinguish original archive records from assessed propositions.

## MCP attachment

The server is `GMRI_REASONING_RECONSTRUCTION_2026-10-29/assistant_mcp.py`. Configure your MCP-capable model client with Python 3 and pass it these arguments (use full resolved paths):

```
--graph /path/to/bundle/GMRI_REASONING_RECONSTRUCTION_2026-10-29/GMRI_recurrent_reasoning_overlay.sqlite
--archive /path/to/bundle/GMRI_GITHUB_LIBRARY_ONLY/GMRI_universal_stage1.sqlite
```

Do not claim this local MCP process is automatically connected to a fresh ChatGPT session: the client must explicitly support or attach the tool. Within an authorized runtime it is usable as a model input, not just a visualization.

## Testing

```sh
cd GMRI_REASONING_RECONSTRUCTION_2026-10-29
python3 -m pytest -q
```

`tests/test_assistant_bridge.py` includes a real MCP subprocess handshake. `tests/test_explicit_intent.py` reproduces false-positive search matches. `tests/test_ingest_current_instructions.py` checks source quotes are not rewritten. No tests use invented source-level confidence or causal labels.

## Authority and privacy

This package contains private user-research material. Keep it locally protected; do not put it on an open website. The MCP server is read-only and has no shell, network, filesystem mutation, or external action tools. Original source messages, later corrections, apparent contradictions, and hypotheses remain independently attributable. Each agent must distinguish an earlier assistant inference from an explicit statement by the operator.

from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile,ZIP_DEFLATED
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from datetime import datetime,timezone

root=Path('/mnt/data/GMRI_ASSISTANT_BRIDGE')
output=Path('/mnt/data/GMRI_ASSISTANT_REASONING_BRIDGE_2026-10-29.zip')
allow=[
    Path('README_FOR_ASSISTANTS.md'),
    Path('START_GMRI_ASSISTANT_MCP.sh'),
]
for sub in ('GMRI_REASONING_RECONSTRUCTION_2026-10-29','GMRI_GITHUB_LIBRARY_ONLY'):
    for f in sorted((root/sub).rglob('*')):
        if not f.is_file():continue
        if '.pytest_cache' in f.parts or '__pycache__' in f.parts:continue
        if f.name.endswith(('.pyc','-wal','-shm')):continue
        # Include runtime, forensic source records, tests, and reference evidence.
        allow.append(f.relative_to(root))
manifest={}
for f in allow:
    p=root/f
    h=sha256()
    with p.open('rb') as src:
        for block in iter(lambda:src.read(1048576),b''):h.update(block)
    manifest[str(f)]={'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'bytes':p.stat().st_size}
(root/'FILE_HASHES.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
allow.append(Path('FILE_HASHES.json'))
with ZipFile(output,'w',ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=2,allowZip64=True) as z:
    for f in allow:z.write(root/f,str(f))
with ZipFile(output) as z:
    assert z.testzip() is None
print('archive',output,'files',len(allow),'bytes',output.stat().st_size)
print('verified source',len(manifest))

def test_passage_search_does_not_rescan_multimegabyte_sources_for_each_hit(tmp_path):
    from assistant_index import build_index,PassageReader
    db,archive,target,_=fixture(tmp_path)
    index=tmp_path/'passages.sqlite';build_index(archive,index)
    reader=PassageReader(archive,index)
    moved=archive.with_name('source_temporarily_offline.sqlite')
    archive.rename(moved)
    # Index search must use its own accurate, bounded passage copies; the
    # later verification tool must still require the original full source.
    hits=reader.search('after reboot orientation changed',limit=4)
    assert any(target in h['passage'] for h in hits)
    assert all(h['source_integrity_verified'] is False for h in hits)
    with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError):reader.get_passage(hits[0]['passage_id'])

"""Build an offline, iPad-capable shared graph teaching viewer from the existing GMRI corpus.
Original source databases are read, never changed. The offline copy includes an index
of every available node/link, only previews of source bodies, not complete 47MB records.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import base64
import gzip
import json
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

BASE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def make_data(archive:Path, reasoning:Path):
    a=sqlite3.connect(archive);r=sqlite3.connect(reasoning)
    nodes=[];edges=[]
    for i,k,label,body,src,event,recorded in a.execute('SELECT id,kind,label,body,source_id,event_ts,recorded_ts FROM nodes'):
        nodes.append({'i':i,'k':k,'t':(label or '')[:180],'q':(body or '')[:480],
                      's':src or '', 'e':event,'r':recorded,'c':'archive'})
    for e_id,src,dst,typ,status in a.execute('SELECT id,src,dst,relation,evidence_state FROM edges'):
        edges.append([src,dst,typ,status,'archive:'+str(e_id)])
    for i,quote,state,src,locator in r.execute('''SELECT p.id,p.quote,p.state,p.source_id,s.locator
                  FROM proposition p JOIN source_document s ON s.id=p.source_id'''):
        nodes.append({'i':i,'k':'proposition','t':quote[:165],'q':quote[:2000],
                      's':src or '', 'loc':locator,'e':None,'r':None,'c':'assessed','state':state})
    for src,dst,typ,warrant,status in r.execute('SELECT src,dst,kind,warrant,status FROM reasoning_relation'):
        edges.append([src,dst,typ,status,'reason:'+src+':'+dst+':'+typ,warrant])
    a.close();r.close()
    return {'version':'GMRI_OFFLINE_INDEX_V1','nodes':nodes,'edges':edges,
            'scope_note':'Complete local node/edge index. Short text previews only. Full source remains in the local databases.',
            'assessed_distinct':True}


def build(archive,reasoning):
    raw=make_data(Path(archive),Path(reasoning))
    dat=json.dumps(raw,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')).encode('utf8')
    compressed=gzip.compress(dat,compresslevel=8)
    (BASE/'data').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (BASE/'data'/'offline_index.json.gz').write_bytes(compressed)
    html=(BASE/'static'/'index.html').read_text()
    js=(BASE/'static'/'app.js').read_text()
    css=(BASE/'static'/'app.css').read_text()
    # Avoid closing a script tag in untrusted source snippets.
    embed=base64.b64encode(compressed).decode('ascii')
    html=html.replace('<!--CSS_INLINE-->',f'<style>{css}</style>')
    html=html.replace('<!--JS_INLINE-->',f'<script>{js}</script>')
    html=html.replace('<!--OFFLINE_SEED-->',f'<script id="gmri-seed" type="application/octet-stream">{embed}</script>')
    target=BASE/'GMRI_Shared_Reasoning_Studio_Offline.html'
    target.write_text(html,encoding='utf8')
    print(json.dumps({'output':str(target),'index_nodes':len(raw['nodes']),
      'index_edges':len(raw['edges']),'json_bytes':len(dat),'gzip_bytes':len(compressed),
      'html_bytes':target.stat().st_size},indent=2))
    return target

if __name__=='__main__':
    import argparse
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--archive',required=True);p.add_argument('--reasoning',required=True)
    args=p.parse_args();build(args.archive,args.reasoning)

def test_roles_cannot_impersonate_each_other(studio):
    from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
    client=TestClient(create_app(studio,token='operator-secret',assistant_token='assistant-secret'))
    op={'X-GMRI-Session':'operator-secret'}
    ai={'X-GMRI-Session':'assistant-secret'}
    event=client.post('/api/teach',headers=op,json={'from':'p1','to':'p2','relation':'FEEDS_BACK','verbatim':'The loop changes the next observation.'}).json()
    assert event['id'].startswith('teach:')
    assert client.post('/api/assistant/reply/'+event['id'],headers=op,json={'text':'Understood'}).status_code==403
    assert client.post('/api/operator/review/'+event['id'],headers=ai,json={'verdict':'accepted'}).status_code==403
    assert client.post('/api/assistant/reply/'+event['id'],headers=ai,json={'text':'Proposed interpretation only.'}).status_code==200
    assert client.post('/api/operator/review/'+event['id'],headers=op,json={'verdict':'accepted'}).status_code==200


def test_import_offline_teaching_packet_into_same_assistant_ledger(studio):
    offline=studio.teach({'from':'p1','to':'b','relation':'REFINES','verbatim':'The memory graph is not a simple retrieval store.','session_id':'lesson-1'})
    text=packet_text(offline)
    with studio._teaching() as c:
        c.execute('DELETE FROM events WHERE id=?',(offline['id'],))
    recovered=studio.import_packet(text)
    assert recovered['id']==offline['id']
    assert recovered['verbatim']==offline['verbatim']
    assert studio.import_packet(text)['id']==offline['id'] # idempotent
    assert studio.verify_audit()['valid']

def test_assessed_quote_must_match_original_source_text(studio):
    with sqlite3.connect(studio.reasoning_path) as c:
        c.execute("UPDATE proposition SET quote='Fabricated replacement claim' WHERE id='p1'")
    with pytest.raises(TeachingError):
        studio.get_node('p1')


def test_integrity_check_detects_stored_event_tamper_not_just_audit_tamper(studio):
    event=studio.teach({'from':'p1','to':'b','relation':'OTHER','verbatim':'Keep this description exactly.','session_id':'lesson-1'})
    assert studio.verify_audit()['valid']
    with studio._teaching() as c:
        c.execute('UPDATE events SET verbatim=? WHERE id=?',('Rewritten behind your back',event['id']))
    assert studio.verify_audit()['valid'] is False

"""Assistant-side CLI for the same GMRI graph and human-authored teaching ledger.

This is deliberately explicit: the assistant must invoke it. It is not automatically
installed as an always-on capability in unrelated ChatGPT conversations.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from studio_core import StudioStore, TeachingError, packet_text


def main(argv=None):
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser(prog='studio_agent')
    p.add_argument('--archive',default=os.getenv('GMRI_ARCHIVE'))
    p.add_argument('--reasoning',default=os.getenv('GMRI_REASONING'))
    p.add_argument('--teaching',default=os.getenv('GMRI_TEACHING','teaching.sqlite'))
    sub=p.add_subparsers(dest='command',required=True)
    sub.add_parser('status')
    sub.add_parser('verify')
    x=sub.add_parser('search');x.add_argument('text');x.add_argument('--limit',type=int,default=24)
    x=sub.add_parser('node');x.add_argument('id')
    x=sub.add_parser('neighbors');x.add_argument('id');x.add_argument('--hops',type=int,default=1)
    x=sub.add_parser('focus');x.add_argument('--session',default='gmri-memory-lab')
    x=sub.add_parser('inbox');x.add_argument('--session',default='gmri-memory-lab')
    x=sub.add_parser('import-packet');x.add_argument('--file',default='-',help='file path or - for stdin')
    x=sub.add_parser('reply');x.add_argument('id');x.add_argument('message')
    x=sub.add_parser('export');x.add_argument('--session',default='gmri-memory-lab')
    args=p.parse_args(argv)
    if not args.archive or not args.reasoning:
        p.error('set --archive and --reasoning to the extracted original GMRI SQLite databases')
    store=StudioStore(args.archive,args.reasoning,args.teaching)
    if args.command=='status':out=store.status()
    elif args.command=='verify':out=store.verify_audit()
    elif args.command=='search':out=store.search(args.text,args.limit)
    elif args.command=='node':out=store.get_node(args.id)
    elif args.command=='neighbors':out=store.neighborhood(args.id,args.hops)
    elif args.command=='focus':out=store.get_focus(args.session)
    elif args.command=='inbox':out=store.inbox(session_id=args.session)
    elif args.command=='import-packet':
        data=sys.stdin.read() if args.file=='-' else Path(args.file).read_text()
        out=store.import_packet(data)
    elif args.command=='reply':out=store.assistant_reply(args.id,args.message)
    elif args.command=='export':out=store.export_session(args.session)
    else:raise AssertionError(args.command)
    print(json.dumps(out,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
    return 0

if __name__=='__main__':
    try:sys.exit(main())
    except (TeachingError,ValueError,FileNotFoundError) as exc:
        print('GMRI STUDIO ERROR: '+str(exc),file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)

def test_agent_cli_retrieves_actual_record_and_imports_packet(studio,tmp_path):
    import subprocess
    src=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'studio_agent.py'
    prefix=['python',str(src),'--archive',str(studio.archive_path),
            '--reasoning',str(studio.reasoning_path),'--teaching',str(studio.teaching_path)]
    result=subprocess.run(prefix+['node','p1'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
    assert json.loads(result.stdout)['quote']=='Mind construction must model feedback'
    e=studio.teach({'from':'p1','to':'b','relation':'FEEDS_BACK','verbatim':'The return path changes what I remember.','session_id':'gmri-memory-lab'})
    with studio._teaching() as c:c.execute('DELETE FROM events WHERE id=?',(e['id'],))
    pkt=tmp_path/'packet.txt';pkt.write_text(packet_text(e))
    r=subprocess.run(prefix+['import-packet','--file',str(pkt)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
    assert json.loads(r.stdout)['id']==e['id']
    r=subprocess.run(prefix+['inbox'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
    assert any(x['id']==e['id'] for x in json.loads(r.stdout)['events'])
